༄tshi/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la4༷༷ bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzodagiX ma hā sarba pu tsa khā hi:༷༷ gtor gzhong 'og tu dam sri mnan pa ni/ dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams4༷༷ sngon gyi thugs dam rgyud bskul gyis4༷༷ dam sri bar chod rdul du rlogagiX bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzodagiX oX le hūṃX legiX dam sri bar chad thams cad nni tri sarba st+waṃ bha ya nan4༷༷ zhesamanan par bya'o/ dpal chen 'khor bcas rol pa'i brogiX dam sri'i snying la chems se chemagiX khro bo khro mo rol pa'i brogiX dgra bgegs snying la chems se chemagiX khro bo rnams kyis bro brdung pas4༷༷ khro mo rnams kyis rgyas 'debs sogiX ig nan4༷༷ big nan4༷༷ stam bha ya nan4༷༷ mā ra ya nan4༷༷ de nasadangosagrub blang ba ni: srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang ltoX dbang dang dngos grub : sogs bya'o/ mchod pa kha gso la/ ambha bdug spos sogs bya'o/ ḍā dril rnga rol dang bcas/ bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i sogs kyisabastod/dal /dkyil 'khor /bsdu ba ni: da ni dkyil 'khosnor gsal btab la4༷༷ zhesasogs bya'o/ /lhag chad kha bskang ba ni/ /ma 'dresar ba dang nyams pa dang / zhesasogs bya'o/ dge ba yongs su bsngo ba ni/ bdag gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba zhesadang / bkra shisaspyi mthun bya'o/ 'dir smrasapa/ mi bsrun bdud sder khrosapa'i me chen nang na rab 'bar de'i nyer bstan/ /zlum po 'khrul ldan mig gi sgor yang dmar gsal nyi ma'i 'od chags lhang / /yun du bsgrub pa'i drag sngagasalas skyesasma smin ag tshom me 'thul ba/ / nag po'i gosagyon dkar ba'i
thor tshugs masang dmar dar gyi rtse banyungs ldan/ /sbrul nag chun po ga shar rgyusal drag pa'i thun gyi dong rtse dpyangs/ /rlung gi khar bskyod dar nag cod pan gyisaklubasalcags kyi phur bu g.yas/ /lcang lor bcas pa'i bhandha'i skyogs snod khrag gisarab gsher g.yon par thogs/ /dpal chen phur bu'i sngags mkhan de la drag po yisakyang nyu byar yod/ /'di na chog khrigs mkhan 'ga' yis/ /phur pa'i rgyud don ma shesapas/ /phyi 'gyur ba yi chog khrigs ltar/ /byasamathong khong pa'i nang du dgad/ /gzhan yang lcam lugs khyi lugs sogs/ /dar yang zab gnad mthar thug min/ /gzung ma mkhar chen lugs 'di ko/ /phur bu yongs kyi srog shing yin/ /mdo rgyud gzhung mang mthong min yang / /gter chosatshul 'dir cha rgyusaldan/ /khyad par phur pa jo lugs 'dir / /smra yang mi nongs don kyang go /phur bu sgrub pa'i cho ga'i khrigs/ /snga 'gyur rgyud sde'i dgongs don ltar/ /'dir bkod 'dir 'bad 'disathob pa'i/ /dge bas 'gro kun yongs grol shog /de ltar dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub skor thams cad kyi nying khu'i yang nying khu/ padma thod 'phreng rtsal gyi thugs tig mkhar chen gza'i thugs dam sprul sku rgod ldem can gyi nyams bzhes/ lha brag gter gyi yang zhun/byang gter brgyud pa'i lam srol chen po 'di rang gi phur pa lugs gsum gyi dgongs pa gcig char du bsdeb pa'i chog khrigs 'di yang / 'jam dpal gling pas kun tu dga' ba'i blo gros can dang / dam tshig gi mched po dpal 'byor grags pa'i dbyangasakyisabaskul ba las/ 'phrin las phur pa'i rig 'dzin chen po bdud 'joms skye sprul/ rje btsun mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug gi dag po'i zhal sgo lasaman ngag gi gnad tig mtha' dag byin gyisabarlabs pa dang lhan nyug tu snying la 'phosapas/ tshul 'di la mi 'jigs pa'i gad rgyang nam mkha'i pha mtha' ma rnyed kyi bar du sgrog par nusapas/

༄tshi/ /dpon gyis bzlas pa'i bum pa'i chu de bdud rtsir gyur par bsamagiX de 'dod pas hab bya byed pa nigiX srid pa'i mes po dbang phyug chen po4༷༷ rgyu khro chu las grub pa'i tri shul 'dzin te4༷༷ des bum pa gcog gin bdud rtsi 'dod par bsamagiX mu stegs shrī ral ba can lag na lcags kyi mda' gzhu thogs pagiX bum pa'i phyed tsam nas phar mda' rgyab nas bdud rtsi 'dod par bsamagiX mu stegs gu lang nag po rgyu lcags las grub pa des rwa rtses bug pa phug nas bdud rtsi 'dod par bsam mogiX lnga ba nigiX slob dpon la slob mas4༷༷ dam tshig tu phyag gsum las mang ba mi 'tshal4༷༷ yon ci 'byor pa dbul la4༷༷ gtso bo khyod kyis bka' drin gyis4༷༷ 'chi med grub pa'i dbang stsol zhigagiX ces zhu'ogiX de nas sterdzob dpon gyis gtor ma gsum bsang sbyangs byas shing ltoX rtsa sngags sham bur ba linta btag la4༷༷ dbang phyugagiX gu lang ltoX shrī ral ba can gsum la dbul zhing ltoX rigs kyi bu 'di rnams la dug srungs shig pa'i phrin las bcol4༷༷ de nas slob dpon gyis4༷༷ rigs mchog rigs las skyes pa'i bugiX 'chi med grub pa'i dbang sbyin gyis4༷༷ tshul 'di gzhan la ma smra zhigagiX gzhan la smras na mgo 'gas 'gyuraltoX gong gi sngags gsum bzlas la4༷༷ chang gis slob ma la gtor zhing ltoX slob dpon gyis slob ma la lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin lhor bstan4༷༷ sdigs mdzub gtadaltoX slob mas sdigs mdzub gyen bstan4༷༷

༄༅/ /bsgral/ phur bu'i rtse mo mgar gyi sol mal nas bton ma thag pa 'dra ba des rigs drug gi sa bon bsregs/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes byi'u lanta ga'i mgo bo tsam zhig 'dug pa de yang bsregs/ rnam shes phur bu'i khong bseng la yar drangs/ rgya mdud 'og ma la khro mo bcu/ gong ma khro kro bcu/ lcim gzhog phra thabs nyi shu yin pas phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du gnas spar te/ tshe lhag gi mli ljang gu phur rtse la blangs/lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis rang gi snying gar bstim pas/ phur bu mkhan po mgo skya yo ge sdod pa yin/ 'di tshogs tha ma'i skabs su bsdus pa re byed/ lhag chog gi mtshams nas dmigs pa 'di skyar zhing skyar zhing dha ti 'dren pa ma gtogs/ rtags ma byung bar liṅga la phur bu 'debs pa dang / gri gug gis gtub pa la rigs rgyu med pas mi bya'o/ dha ti 'dus pa'i snying po 'diljoX stong phrag gsum du bzlas par bya4༷༷zhes gsungs kyang rtags ma byung na lo brgya yang lhag tsam dgos so/ rtags byung dus kyang lan gsum bzhi tsam ma byung bar mi bsgral/ de nas bsgral la dum bu gcig me la bsregs/ gcig gtor stegs kyi 'og tu mnan/ gcig klu yod nges pa'i chu mig tu bor la ma btang zhig ces bsgo'o/ oX badzra kī laṃ kī la ya sarba big nan peṃ hūṃX phaṭa4༷༷ bcu bzhi pa'o/ dzaXhūṃX ā:༷༷ bsnan pas bcu drug pa'o/ /dha ti ni de'i khar ma raklo
yasmo ka la ru pa/ snying rtsa la yaṃ yogiX srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ snying la phril phril/ srog la chum chum/ tsitta srog la tung tung / snying khrag shad thum ri liṃ liṃ/ snying rtseg rtseg 'ur 'ur/ shig shig 'gul 'gul/myags myags/ sod sod/ dha ti ma ma garmā shwe kṛ kaṃ gar myags ye ma ra sa ni pra mar dha ni ye hūṃX phaṭa4༷༷ mtshams thon rgyu'i snga dro yang cho ga tshar gcig btang la sngar dal /dkyil 'drar /gyi byang shar mtshams su bsags pa'i lhag ma rnams la kha chu btab cing btang / chad tho btang ba dngos grub len pa bzod gsol dal /dkyil 'khor /bsdu ba/ bkra shis sogs las byang kho bos khrigs su byas pa de kho na bzhin no/ /rgyal po bzhi la tho 'grol ba'i gtor ma sbyin la sku mtshams grol lo/ /bsnyen rtags ni/ khrag 'thung ba yi zhal mthong zhing ltoX phyag mtshan phur bu gar du khrabaltoX gtor ma rakta bdud rtsi khol4༷༷ zhes so/ grub rtags ni rgya mtsho hub kyis drang ba dang ltoX nyi zla zhabs kyis mnan pa dang ltoX ri bo klad la bskor ba dang ltoX zhes so/ /las sbyor gyi rtags ni/ 'bri skad du ngur ba dang / bya skad du gnong ba dang / ra skad du sla ba rnams ni bla khug pa'i ltas dang / 'gor dang ling byas sems can bsadagiX grong khyer me yis bcom pa dang ltoX ha ha gad mo 'debs gyur na4༷༷ nges par sgrol ba'i rtags yin no4༷༷ zhes gsungs so/ deng sang 'di na
༄tshi/ /zab phod gser rnga dang / /rgya sbug hor bsil 'bag 'cham sku ber sogs/ /'grig 'grig mdzes mdzes dod dod mang na yang / /pha rol dgra des brnyas tshe nus pas dben/ gu ru padmas gnubs chen sangs rgyas la/ /gra sgrigs gzigs mor che ba'i khrigs med kyang / /sde brgyad dbang bsdud zhing bcu tshar gcod pa'i/ /gnad tig man ngag yod pas de khas chog /gu ru padma'i gong khug nas byung man ngag gser gyi yang zhun 'di/ /bi to ta ma lar grags 'bum sde'i chu gter nang 'khrungs de lta na'ang/ /gyi nar mngon 'dor khyi lugs dang ni sa lugs zhes btags bcos ma'i chos/ /dbyangs su gyer la phur bu mkhan por mngon rlom de nyid shes pa med/ /kha gcig lhar shing phur bu mang tshogs pas/ /lha nag zhes grags gser dngul zangs lcags sogs/ /du ma tshogs la lha khra zhes zer lo/ /mkhyen ldan sngags pa'i tshogs kyi ma gsan tam/ 'o na tsan dan dmar po'i zangs ma yis/ /phur bu 'ba' zhig tshogs la lha dmar dang / /ra gan phur bu tshogs la lha ser zhes/ /khyed cag ming du 'dogs sam gad mo'i gnas/ /'ga' zhig srid pa'i phur bu mi 'thad de/ /srid pa phur bu bsgrub pa yin no lo/ /'o na srid pa phur bu'i rnam gzhag kyang / /'god par byed dam da bzod smra bar byos/ /bzlog par ma nus gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog /spyir bor
lhung bas smre sngags 'byin nam dang / /shes ldan gzu bor gnas pa don gnyer ba/ de dag kun la snying brtses 'di smras so/ /khro bcu yab yum phra thabs sgo mar bcas/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku smad phur pa'i dbyibs sku mdog mthing nag 'ba' zhig par nges la/ /lha nag zhes grags gtan tshigs bzang pos 'grub/ /de bzhin lha tshogs ma nges sna tshogs mdog /de phyir lha khra zhes grags tshul 'di la/ /yongs 'dris drag sngags 'chang rnams 'di bzhe pas/ /rgyu khyad yin zhes phyin chad ma smra zhig /zur gsum dbal la ngan song gnas rdzogs shing / /rgya mdud 'og ma 'dod khams lcim gzhogs la/ /gzugs khams rgya mdud gong mar gzugs med kyi/ /lha tshogs gnas pas srid pa'i phur bur bshad/ /de phyir phur mtshams tsam zhig bca' bsgrigs nas/ /sde dpon che khra'i dbu bskor su mkhas la/ /phur bu mkhan po'i brda' chad mi 'jug pas/ /pad 'byung rgyal ba'i lung bzhin 'dris par byos/ /dang por mtshan nyid kun ldan bla mas bzung / /bar du rgyud dang man ngag glegs bur bltas/ /tha mar nor 'brul med pa'i nyams len byas da ni phur bu mkhan po'ang yin no snyam/ /rtsa dum tsam gyis tshig rigs la rten nas/ /'grel med 'grel pa'i yi ge ma byed cing / /phyis 'gyur cho gas rgyas 'debs blos byas mkhan/ /de 'dra'i phur
༄༅/ /mkhan phal gyi do zla min/ /dge 'dis yang zab gter ma'i ring lugs bzhin/ /bskyed rdzogs bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor yongs grub pa'i/ /sngags 'chang ral pa'i khur ldan mang 'phel nas/ /gsang sngags bstan pa srung ba'i dge legs stsole/ /rtags kyi phur bus bstan pa'i 4 ༅ bsgral/ /thabs kyi phur bus yab yum sterdzom par 'jug /don gyi phur bus ma rig mtshan 'dzin gyi/ /rtog tshogs dbyings su 〉rdzol thigata sngags 'chang rnams/ zhesapas 'di yang khams rgan shesarab skya 'bol phur bu mkhan po zhig byed par 'dod nas yang yang bskul ngor/ phur bu mkhan po thams cad kyi mesapo sna nam rdo rje bdud 'jom kyi sprul pa'i skur rtsod bral gyi lung gisagrub cing zhal gyisabazhesapa rje btsun mthu stobasakyi dbang phyug ngag gi dbang po'i drin las lcags khyi sa gsum gyi man ngag la yi ger rtog ge rang byed ma dgosapas/ padma thod phreng gi man ngag bcosaslad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa cha tsam khongs su chud pasanyams su blang ba dang / gzhan la 'doms pa la yang mi 'jigs pa'i spobasapa grub pa/ stobasaldan dpa' bosaganam sa gru gsum du rang bzhin gyisagrub pa'i drag po'i gnas chen he ru pa'i pho brang dam par snga dra'i cha la dbu brtsams te nyi ma phyed yol tsam la grub pa bgyisapa'o/ / lar sprang ma'i glu lhan tu snyan cing don dang ldan yang yi ger 'debasapa med pa ltar/ chosamadzad slob dpon kyi bskul nas gcig /rgyal sras gzhon nu gsang ba'i bdag posabaskul nas ga:ga /'di dang bcas pa'i sngar nasakyang gsum tsam byas te dpe rgyun che chen po ma byung bas/ mi re la bsnyen thabs re byed dgosabyung bas/ da dung yang 'ga' 'byon nam snyam/ sarba maṅgalaX/
༄7/ /byang gter phur pa lugs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bya (tsugli) bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄tshi/ /na mo badzra ku mā ra yā/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las 'khor lo'i lha/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nur legs shar ba/ /bsnyen sgrub bdud kyi g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /'phrin las sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde'u mig 'bri/ /de la 'dir bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'phrin las ma lus pa gcig tu 'dus pa'i bdag nyid bar chad kyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha rdo rje phur ba zhes sangs rgyas gnyis pa o rgyan chen po'i thugs dam gong khug ma jo mo lugs su grags pa la bka' gter gnyis su bzhugs pa'i phyi ma la gter kha 'ga' zhig yod pa'i lha brag mdzod lnga 'dus pa'i lho gser mdzod ser po'i zab gter las byon pa'i phur pa lugs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi man ngag la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni che mchog dang drag sngags ltar nod pa'am/ yang lcags
'tshi/ /khang ma'i dbang shin tu rgyas par ma tshang ba rnams che mchog nas kha bskang ba mtha' ma'i che mchog dang drag sngags gang yang rung ba'i dbang gis chu bo ma nub cing dam tshig gi sel ma zhugs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis drung du smin byed kyis dbang legs par mnos pa/ rgyab rten gyi lung sogs nyams su blang bya'i chos rnams la sgro 'dogs mtha' chod par byas nas sngags gsar ma'i rgyas 'geb kho na lhur blangs pa la re ba 'cha' mi dgos par shog ser gyi dri ma kha chi li ba'i gdengs tshad dang / rgyud las/ ri bran mang po 'dus pa'i phyiragaX ri bo'i bskor ba'i lcug phran tshalagaX ri mtho sa gtsang nags tshal ldanagaXshin tu dben pa'i sa phyogs sugaX zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i mtshon te/ sgrub chen gyis sngon 'gro nas bshad pa'i gnas grogs yo byad sogs sta gon legs par byas/ bsnyen sgrub la shis pa'i gza' skar dus
sbyor dang bstun pa'i yar ngo'am/ yang na mar ngo la'ang rung bas bsnyen pa'i dus kyi yun tshad dang gza' tshes sogs la skabs dang sbyar nas gnas khang byi dor bya/ sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs bkod pa'i mdzes shing /rig 'dzin brgyud pa yi dam chos srung gi bris 'bur gyi sku byin rlabs can bkram/ sgrub rdzas rnams zhal lhor gzigs pa'i dbang du byas pa'i steg bu'am cog rtse lta bu ci rigs pa'i steng du sgrub gtor sku rten tsa ka li'i brgyan pa'i steng du dar nag gis gdugs phub pa/ sman raka phyi nang gi nyer spyod rol mo/ phur srung gter srungs/ gzhan yang gtor bsngo gang byed kyis chos srung gi mchod gtor/ rgyal chen bzhi dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/ tshogs las sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bkod/ zhal sprod kyis tshul du byang gzigs kyis sgrub pa po'i steg gyis 'og tu rus pa'am 'bru dkar po'i steng g.yung drung ris chos 'khor du bri/skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje srin po'i nga rgyal la gnas pas bsnyen phur la byug bdug brab gsum gyis sgo nas gzi byin bskyed pa'i phyag len dmigs pa dang bcas pa dam pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi las ji ltar byung ba ltar lag tu ltar te sgrub gtor gyi logs mdun du phur gdan la zhal tshul gzigs pa'i tshul gyis btsugs/ bgegs la dkar gtor dmar gtor byin nas bka' bsgo zhing gu gul gyis dud pas bdug
༄༅/ /yungs thun rol mo dang bcas pa'i tsha rngams kyis bskrad/ mtho bzhi la rgyal po bzhi'i sku dang bcas te rgyal chen mtho 'dzug gzhung bzhin byed/ srung 'khor bsgom zhing sgo srung du mtho dkar po zhig brtsigs gognyis pa dngos gzhi la/ srod thun nas 'phrin las kyis gzhung bsrings/ bzlas pa'i mgor phreng ba byin gyis brlab pa zab gter 'di nyid kyis khyad chos bzhin 'phyugs med du bya/ rang rdo rje phur pa gsal ba'i thugs par nyi ma'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' yab dang tshul mtshungs pa rgyan med pa tshon gang pa gcig gsal btab pa'i thugs par rdo rje rtse dgu pa nas 'bras tsam gyis lte bar gsung gi ngo bo hūm̐X yig sngon po spus bris pa tsam gyi mtha' bskor du gsang ba'i yi ge bcu bzhi pa spu shad tsam kyis bskor ba gsal 'debs pa ni/ rgyud las thugs par ye shes sems dpa' nyidagaX rgyan med yab dang tshul mthun pagaX tshon gang ba zhig bsgom par bya4༷༷ de'i thugs par phyag mtshan gyi4༷༷ rdo rje rtse dgu nas 'bru tsam4༷༷ de yi lte bar gsung gi rtags4༷༷ hūm̐X sngon spu yis bris pa tsam4༷༷ de yi mtha' mar kī la ya4༷༷ gser mdog skra shad tsam gyis bskoraltoX zhes pa'i don no/ /khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i mdun du bsnyen phur rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum zhal sprod kyi tshul du skad cig gis bskyed/ bdag mdun gnyis pa'i thugs pa'i hūm̐X las 'od zer 'phros te sdig sgrib sbyang ba man ngag
ltar byed/ yang 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad yi dam lha'i rnam par rong rong gyur pa/ bdag mdun phur gsum la bstim pa dang / de bzhin du bcud thams cad lha dang / snod thams cad gzhas yas khang du bsgyur nas so sor byin gyis brlab pas rten brten pa bkrag dang gzi mdangs rgyas par bsam/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐X las 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa'i shangs phug g.yas nas 'thon/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rang gi sna bug g.yas nas phyir 'phros/ mdun gyi gtso po'i shangs bug g.yon du zhugs/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yon par zhugs te song ba ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i hūm̐X yig la phog pas thugs dam gyis rgyud bskul/ de las 'od zer phyir 'phros ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yas nas thon sku'i dbyibs brgyud mdun bskyed kyi shangs bug g.yas nas phyir byung ste rang gi g.yon du zhugs/ rim pa bzhin ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yon nas brgyud ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la phogade lta bu'i dmigs pa 'gal me 'khor lo ltar bya/ yang phrin las rnam bzhi'i dmigs pa spyi dang bye brag thams cad kyang skabs thob kyi phye ba'i zhal shes ltar bya/ snying mdzod las gsung pa'i thun mongs min pa'i bsrung 'khor drug po gter gzhung gi rdo rje'i tshig la man ngag gis mdud
༄tshi/ /pa dkrol ba bzhin 'tshub che chung dang bstun pa'i nyams su len/ mjug tu rang gi thugs kha'i 'od zer gyis thugs rgyud bskul bas mdun bskyed kyis sku de las mar me gcig la gnyis chad kyis tshul du so sor byung nas gcig 'dzab phur la thim/ gcig shas je chung du song ba mthar rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs thugs kha'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim pas bdag dang phur ba gnyis ka gzi mdangs rgyas par bsam / thun mthar dbyangs gsal gyi mjug tu spel tshig btags pa lan bdun brjod/ tshogs thog mtha' bar gsum phur srung gter srung mchod cing bskang ba byed/ bsnyen pa la tshogs nub re bzhin gyi spros pa mi dgos pas mi gtong / phyis lhag ma chad tho bstan skyong rnams gzhung bzhin btang / slar bdag skyed gsal btab ste mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ rten brten pa thams cad skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba'i sems kyi rol rtse tsam du thag bcad nas ye stong ka dag gi ngang du lhod kyi glod/ slar yang lhun grub 'od lnga'i rang mdangs 'ja' tshon lta bur lam gyi 'char bcug ste dge ba bsngo/ 'dzab bzla bzhin pa'i ngang nas dgung thun la gnyid log thor thun snga thun dgong thun gsum dang rjes kyi srod rnams la phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang kyang rung mod/ sngags gsar ma ltar de ltar ma byas na chad lhag du gyur gyi dgos pa'i the tshom lugs srol
'di la bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i gzhung sgra ji bzhin pa nyams len gyis spros bcas la'ang / lhun grub 'dus ma byas 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i klong du rtsis zin pa'i gnad 'gag gis blo 'tshub dang / sbub 'thum ma dgos pa'i/ mi spro na thun g.yin gsum la mngon rtog bsdus pa zhig gis gsal btab rjes bar chad bsrung dmigs dang dbyangs gsal la spel tshigs btags pa 'dzab kyis ngang nas gnyid log pa gsum po spang ba'i srod thun ji lta ba'i bzlas brjod dang mchod bstod/ ka dag gis rdzogs rim/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams dkyus bzhin bya/ snga thun la khyad chos thun 'gor 'bru gsum gyi mjug tu dbyangs gsal spel tshig zhabs bcad ma btags pa bdun brjod/ khams cung zad seng ba sogs kyi dus phreng ba la mdud pa rgyab nas gdan steng du 'jog thun mtshams su gang 'os shig tu dge sbyor gyis rigs gzhan dang / phur srung / gter bsrung gzhi bdag mchod pa sogs byed/ bsnyen tshad ni/ rdo rje phur pa thugs gsang sku'i rgyud las/ sa ya drug 'bum bsnyen pa'i tshadagaX de rdzogs nas ni rtags 'di 'byung ltoX khrag 'thung nga yi zhal mthong zhing ltoX phyag mtshan phur bu gar du 'khrabazhiX gtor ma rakta bdud rtsi kholagaX zhes gsungs pas/yig 'bru bcu bzhi ba'i bsnyen rkyang la/ drag po rang byung rang shar las/ brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba bzlas4༷༷ zhes pa ltar sngags snying ma'i
'tsho/ /lugs su bye ba sngon du btang ba'i sa ya 'dren pas shin tu 'grus pa'i dbang du byas na thun re la khri tsho re cha bzhag tshe zla ba brgyad 'gor zhing / nyin zhag rer khri tsho tsam gyi rtsis byas na lo gcig la bsnyen pa thebs rbersha/ /de nas bsgrub pa ni/ rgyud las sa gzhi nag la gting zab pagaX gnam sa gnyis ka drag po'i gzugs4༷༷ brag nag ngos rgyar gdug pa 〈coX drag po'i sa la maṇḍal bya4༷༷ dbus su gru gsum tha ma 〈coX zla gam gsum gyis bskor ba dang ltoX khyams sgo rta babs la sogs tegaX dkyil 'khor rgyan rnams rdzogs par 'bri4༷༷ zhes pa ltar dur khrod kyi sa la sogs pa drag po'i rdzas sna bsres pa'i stegs bu ro sol gyis kha dog nag por byas pa la gri khrag gis chag chag btab/ sa rtags blang por bsgrub chen nas bshad pa'i spros pa dor/ bgegs gtor/ rgyal chen tho 'dzugs rnams sngon du phur cha dgod/ de tsam ma lcogs na tshon gyi rnam bzhag rnams dor ba'i ras bris la phur cha dgod shin tu bsdu na rtsa ba'i thig chen brgyad logs thig dang bcas btab par phur cha dgod/ phur cha yongs rdzogs ma rnyed na khro bcu/ phra phyag /sgo ba sogs la rdul tshon gyi skabs tshon spung ngam/ phyag mtshan 'bri ba gang rung / ras bris la sku dang mtshan ma gang bris de ga dang / bsdu na 'khor rnams la 'bru'i tshom bu bkod pa'i rung la/ gtso bo'i phur pa dang las phur gnyis ni med du mi rung ba'o/
mdun du mañdza'i khri la sgrub gtor g.yas su sman dang g.yon tu rakta byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog shar du mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ lhor me tog bdug sbos/ nub tu mar me dri chab/ byang du zhal zas/khrag gi arghaX/ dbang po'i me tog sogs 'dod yon nang gis mchod pa rnams kyis mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bsham/ sgrub gtor bka' srung gi mchod pa rnams sngar bsnyen pa'i skabs bshams pa de ga yod na gsar du ma bzos kyang chog srod thun nas 'go bzung ste thun bzhir gcod pa sogs bsnyen pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ 'on kyang dmigs pa'i khyad par bdag bskyed kyis bsrung 'khor gzhas yas khang bsgom pa dang lhan du gtso po dang rnam rgyal gyis bar der gzhal yas khang bsgom/ de bzhin du lha rnams kyang bdag mdun gnyis ka dus gcig tu me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar gsal btab ste bdag mdun gyi gtso po gnyis ka zhal sprod kyi tshul gyis gzhung bsrang / gtso bo dril sgrub ltar bskyed na bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'bor phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gsum ga tshang bar lugs 'di tshad mar gyur pa'i sngags rgan ral pa can rnams bzhed do/ /chos dbang rin po che'i phur pa spu gri la sras mchog rigs bzhi'i tha snyad ma gsung kyang / byang gter gyi phur pa 'bring po sras mchog rigs bzhi'i rnam bzhag mtshan ldan ngag
༄tshi/ /dbang grags pa sogs mkhas grub rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bsgom par spro na rnam rgyal gyis mdun du budha kī la ya/ de bzhin gshin rje/ rta mgrin/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gsum gyi mdun du rim bzhin/ ratna/parma / garma kī la ya rnams bsgom/ gzungs thag 'then/ sgrub pa'i sngags ni/ yig 'bru bcu bzhi pa la dzaXhūṃX āXgasum bsnan pa'i bcu bdun pa la bsnyen tshad ni/ gsang rgyud las/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa bye ba gsum4༷༷rtags bsnyen rtags byung bar du bzla4༷༷ zhes bye ba gsum bzla bar gsungs pas thun re la khri phrag re 'gro ba'i dbang du byas na zla ba phyed gsum la bsnyen tshad thems/ sgrub pa kho na'i dbang du btang ste thun bzhi ka la las byang gi gzhung bsdus tsam re btang / dgong thun gyi mthar tshogs bsdus re btang ba'i tshogs lhag dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar mtshams su spung ba sogs phyag len ltar byed/ sgrub rtags ni/ rgyud las/ stong gsum zhabs kyi brjis pa dang ltoX nyi zla khong du mid pa dang ltoX ri rab lag gis bskor ba dang ltoX rgya mtsho hub kyis btung ba dang ltoX dngos sam nyams sam rmi lam dugaX grub pa'i rtags re nges par 'byung ltoX zhes so/ de nas las sbyor ni/ /rgyud las/ maṇḍal gru gsum rim pa gsum4༷༷ zangs lcags mkhar ba'i phye ma lagaX khrag rgod bsres la byug par bya4༷༷ drag po'i shing la zur gsum rtsang ltoX nyer gcig srin mo'i 'gros su bya4༷༷ rnam shes tshang ba'i
liṅga bris4༷༷ zhes pa ltar/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du phur ba sogs drag po'i rdzas kyi 'brub khung kha khyer rtsang sogs phyag len ltar rngam brjid dang ldan par bshams/ lugs srol 'di pa'i man ngag las byung ba'i liṅga sngags can rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyis drod rlangs ma yal ba phyag len ltar bris te hom khung du bcug phur srung bskul pa dgug 'dren/ lha dbye sogs yid ches par byas/ thun bzhi la las sbyor gyi sngags sgrub sngags kyi mjug tu dha ti rnam gsum gyis sngags btags pa 'dren no/ /sngags ni/ drang po gter ston gsum pa yol mo ba chen po'i gsungs pas bsnyen yig ltar bzla zhing thun bzhi pa'i mjug tu thun brdeb/rtags rdzogs nas bdun gcig tsam nas phur gdab sogs bsgral las yongs su rdzogs par byas te/ rgyud las/ cha gcig dug shing me la bsregazhiX cha gcig klu la gtad par bya4༷༷ cha gcig gtor stegs 'og tu mnanagaX zhes pa ltaraltoX mnan sreg gi mjug bsdu/ 'di la zhal shes dang drag sngags smyi sdom gnad la nang byan tshud dgos/ dgra dmigs bsal med cing mtshon don tsam byed na zan ling gis kyang go chod do/ /gdab kha drug 'khrul med du nyams su len par 'dod na/ mthong brgyud kyi phyag bzhes dmar 'khrid las shes par bya'o/ /mtshams grol rgyu'i zhogs pa las byang rgyas pa tshogs mchod dang bcas pa 'bul/ phur cha/ sgrub gto
'tsho/ /ra sogs sgrub rdzas rnams la bskul tshig gi sgo nas dngos grub len pa snga 'gyur spyi gzhung ltar byed/ sngar kyi tshogs lhag rnams dang bcas te tshogs lhag gtong / chad tho/ bstan skyong / dkyil 'khor bsdu chogsmon lam/ bkra shis/ rgyal tho 'grol ba sogs lag len gzhung bzhin bya/ nang mtshams grol nyin dam ldan 'ga' zhig dang 'phrad/ mig dgra dang nyi zla'i phyogs su lta stangs byed/ gzhan la srung ba sogs byin rlabs kyis rigs byed pa/ nang mtshams nang gi dngos po phyir gtong ba/ skra sen 'breg pa/ mchil ma 'dor ba/ phreng ba la reg pa sogs srungs/ thog ma nas mtshams khong tu ma bcug pa'i mi/ dngos po/ yi ge sogs mi gtong bas mtshon te bsnyen sgrub kyi dam tshig la gnas pa ni shin tu gces so/ /'di ni phur pa 'bring po spu gri la sbyar ba'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi dbang du btang ba yin la/ bsnyen tshad ha cang mang pas skyid lug na/gsham ni gong du bshad pa'i sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor phur cha sogs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung la sngags kyang 'bru bcu bdun pa bzla/ thun re re bzhin las byang gtong ba/ dgong thun la tshogs gtong ba rnams spangs te bsnyen pa ltar nyams su blang pa'i grangs bsnyen bye ba gsum btang nas bsnyen sgrub zung 'brel du 'grub pa 'jug pa bde ba'i gnad dam pa sprul pa'i sku yol mo ba chen po'i yang thugs gcig tu mdzad do/ de
nas sgrub pa ni bsnyen sgrub zung 'brel du song bas go chod mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa ltar sa bcad ma stong tsam byed na gsang rgyud le'u bdun pa nas gsungs pa'i dha ti'i sngags 'bru nyer bdun pa zhags gsum gyis bar bzla zhing / rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi spro bsdus dkyil 'bor gyi lha tshogs dang phur srung rnams kyis thugs brgyud bskul bar dmigs te bzla/ de yang rgyud las/ dha ti 'dus pa'i snying po 'diljoX stong phrag gsum du bzlas par bya4༷༷ dam can dngos su 'du bar 'gyuraltoX thun re la stong phrag bzla ba'i dbang du yin zhing / de las mang ba byung na legs so/ /las sbyor man ni gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /yang che mchog gi bsnyen sgrub las gsum bya bar 'dod na/ bsnyen pa ni las byang brje ba tsam las khyad par med/ sgrub pa'i skabs sku'i rgyud las/ sku gsung thugs kyi phur pa gsum4༷༷ sku shar gsung lho thugs ni byang ltoX zla gam gsum la 'god par bya4༷༷ zhes lugs 'di dang chos dbang gis spu gri sogs la sras mchog rigs lnga'i tha snyad mi byed par sku gsung thugs kyi phur pa gsum zla gam gsum la bkod/ phur cha bying bkod lugs 'dra/ mar khu khrag zhag 'o ma bzhi/ /dkyil 'khor bar 'khyams dag tu bzhag /ces rdzas bzhi po yang dgod rang che mchog rdo rje gzhon nu dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad par gsal ba'i gnas gsum du sku gsung thugs kyi sras phur pa
ra༅bya/ /sor gsum po gsal gdab/ rgyud man ngag ltar sgrub sngags gsum ka sgril nas bzla/ dril sgrub ni/ bsnyen pa drag sngags lha nag dang 'dra/ sgrub pa'i skabs/ sgrub sngags la khro bcu'i sngags btags pa'o/ /de ltar 'phrin las dpal chen he ru ka/ lugs gsum phur pa grags pa lha brag gter/ /o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i gong khug ma/ /jo mo lugs srol kun gyi yang rtser son/ /tshul 'di'i smin grol gdam pa'i gnad 'gags rnams/ /rig 'dzin zhal lung mkha' 'gro'i kha rlungs can/ /zur chen 'jam dbyangs bla ba'i bka' drin las/ /legs thob snying gi ze'u 'bru rtag tu brten/ /la la bdag mdun bca' gzhi'i spros pa sogs/ /ma shes rdzogs chen spros bral lta ba yis/ /ming tsam rdzu la bsten pa'i zol sbyor gyi/ /zog gi rang gzhan gnyis ka phung ba'ang mthong / /kha gcig snga 'gyur rnams dbye ma dod par/ /kye rdor la sogs phyi 'gyur cho ga yis rgyas bkab smig rgyus skom nad sel 'dod pa'i/ /mkhas rloms nam mkha'i 'ja' la sbar 'dzin 'dra/ /rig 'dzin padma'i thugs tig sna nam par/ /legs gdams rgod kyi ldem 'phrur bka' babs pa'i/ /zab don rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i lugs srol bzhin/ /'bri ba'i ngo mtshar skal bzang 'di na rnyed/ /de 'dra snga 'gyur bstan 'dzin kun gyi rje/ /byang bdag rig 'dzin mchog gi sprul pa'i gar/ /legs bsgyur dam ldan rdo
rje'i slob ma yi/ /bzhed skongs theg mchog bstan la bsam nas bkod/ /dge des log par 'khu ba'i dgra sde'i dpung / /sras mchog badzra kī las bsgral ba dang / /lhan cig bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dgra tshogs kun/ /rang rig don gyi phur bus sgrol gyur cig /ces lha brag gter byon gyi phur pa lugs gsum ga'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bya tshul bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba zhes pa 'di yang rigs sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor lo'i bsgyur ba byang ba rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i sprul pa'i gar mkhan bya nag gi rigs su 'khrungs pa blo bzang padma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sde'i gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te/gter kha 'di nyid la se ston chen po'i gdams pa rig 'dzin mnga' ris legs ldan rje las nye bar brgyud pa dang / se ston chen po'i man ngag mnyams med nub dgon pa las brgyud pa gnyis tshogs chu bo gcig 'dus dpal chos kyi rgyal po bkra shis stobs rgyal nas gter ston yol mo ba chen po'i bar du byon pa'i smin byed dbang lung phyag bzhes kyi bka' babs zur chen rigs kun khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol la nos shing rig 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po nas bkra bzang se ston thugs mchog 'od 'bar gyi bar du byon pa'i dbang dang man ngag skyid ston tshe ring dbang po'i zhal shes/ phur pa lha khra'i chos sde las byung ba'i tshe dbang lha khrid
༄༅/ /gsum zur ngag dbang phun tshogs las brgyud pa rnams mkhas grub khra tshangs pa chen po las thob te tshad ldan gyi rdo rje slob dpon rnams la yun ring du bsten pa'i bka' drin las chos tshul 'di la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa dge ba'i za hor gyi sngags smyon drag po rtsal gyis lcags pho byi lo khrums kyi zla ba'i yar tshes dgu la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /
(nyu)༄khya/ /byang gter phur pa lugs gsum las dril sgrub las byang dmigs rim zin bris rnam nges kyi tshul du bkod pa bzhugs so/
༄༅/ /na ma shri badzra ku ma ra ye hūṃ/ rgyal kun 'phrin las ngo bo phur pa'i lha/ /rnam rol dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs dang / /rigs kyi bdag po rtsa ba'i bla ma lacaX deng nas byang chub bar du phyag bgyi'o/ /lha brag gter byon phur pa lugs gsum las/ /khyad par gyur pa gong khug jo mo lugs/ /yang gsang spu gri 'bar ba'i cho ga'i khrid/ /dmigs rim zin bris go bder 'dri ba la/ /bla ma mkha' 'gros gnang ba stsal du gsol/ /de yang yi dam khyad par can 'di nyid kyi byon tshul lo rgyus rgya mtsho tsam zhig mchis pa las 'dir chu thig tsam zhig bri bar byed pa la/ dang por ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po/ dus phun sum tshogs pa dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid gyi dus/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams su/ skye med mtha' bral chen po'i
༄tsho/ /dgongs pa las ma g.yos bzhin du/ 'gags med cho 'phrul bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum du skur bzhengs te thabs shes gnyis su med par sbyor ba las/ 'khor phun sum lhutogs par phyogs bcu khro bo phra thabs/ phur pa sras kyi dkyil 'khor du mngon par sprul nas/ chos phun sum tshogs pa bi to ta ma la 'bum sde sogs phrin las phur pa'i rgyud mtha' dag gsungs so/ /rgyud sde de dag kyang ston pa nyid dang rdo rje sems dpa'/ phyag na rdo rje sogs kyis bsdus te/ mkha' 'gro sgrib sde ltar ma las kyi dbang mo che la gtad/ chosadabang phur pa spru gri des rdo rje phur pa'i skor rnams rus pa'i sgrom bur bcug nas slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la gtad pa dang / rgyud sde ltar yang byang gter rang lugs ltar brgyud tshul phyag na rdo rjes rgyal po dza la rgyud kyi glegs bam char du phab te don gyi
rgyud gtadagiX des za hor gyi slob dpon pra bha 'di rab tu byung ba'i mtshan shākya pra bha zhesagrags rong phur ltar ha ti la gtad/ des slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la gtad/ yang kun tu bzang po rdo rje gzhon nu la gnang / des bram ze mi yi thod pa can la gnang / des mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo che la gnang / des mchod rten bde byed brtsegs par gter du sbas/ de shri seng has spyan drangs te za hor slon dpon pra bha ha shākya 'od ti la gnang des lha lcam u ma de sha la/ des slon dpon padma 'byung gnas la gnang / yang kun tu bzang pos rdo rje sems dpa' la gtad/ des dga' rab rdo rdze la/ des sangs rgyas rnam gzigs sprul ba bzhad pa rdo rdze la/ des rgyal po u ru sha ni/ des klu yi bu mo rgya mtsho la/ des rgyal po mrant+ra bo ti la/ des dha na rog ston dang ratna'i phur brgyud sogs kyi brgyud tshul dang ha lam mthun saṃ skṛ ta la/ des slob dpon padma / bi ma la mi tra/bal po shrī la mnyu gsum la bshad/ de'i nang phrin las phur pa'i chos skor 'dir la mchog tu bka' babs cing nyi zla ltar grags pa ni khiwa rgyan chen po padma 'byung gnas nyid yin la/ de ltar slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas nyid ni dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis shing gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud man ngag
༄tshi/ /thams cad gtad nas snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba yin cing / khyad par phrin las phur pa'i bka' babs tshul bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i 'o( rgyus las sgrub pa bka' brgyad spyi dang bye brag gi rgyud sde rnams 'og min du ston pas kun bzang he ru ka gsungs/ gsang ba'i bdag pos bsdus te rjesasu glegs bam la bkod nas mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi gtso mo las kyi dbang mo la gtad/mkha' 'gro mas che mchog gi rgyud dang man ngag chosanyid kyi rang sgra la rnams gser gyi sgrom bur bcugagiX yang dag dngul gyi sgrom bur bcugagiX gshin rje lcags kyi sgrom bur bcugagiX padma zangs kyi sgrom bur bcug ltoX phur pa g.yu'i sgrom bur bcugagiX ma mo bse yi sgrom bur bcugagiX 'jig rten mchong gis sgrom bur bcugagiX drag sngags gzi yi sgrom bur bcugagiX bka' brgyad gcig tra sa ni rin po che sna brgyad kyi sgrom bur bcugagiXdur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal gyi mchod rten bde byed brtsegs par gter du sbas pa las/ dus nam zhig grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad byon te dur khrod chen po brgyad du bsgrub pa mdzad ste sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi rgyud sde rnams gter nas/ spyan 'dren pa'i dur la babs te/ rig 'dzin rnams mchod rten bde byed brtsegs par byon nas/ ye shes dang las kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams dbang du bsdu bar mdzad pas mkha' 'gro'i
gtso mo dngos su byon nas ñtsu dgos gsung pa la/ rig 'dzin rnams kyi bsgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi rgyud sde rnams 'dod gsung pas/ mkha' 'gro mas bka' rgya dkrol te gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor rnams slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la gtad/ padma gsung slob dpon klu sgrub la gtad/ yang dag thugs hūṃ ka ra la gtad/ bdud rtsi yon tan bi ma mi tra la gtad/ phur pa slob dpon padma la gtadagiX srid pa ma mo dha na saṃ kri ta la4༷༷ 'jig rten gu ya tsant+ra la4༷༷ drag sngags shinti gharbha la gtad/ de nas slob dpon so so'i yi dam dang de'i bka' babs kyi rgyud sde rnams gtan la phab te dar rgyas su mdzad/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la rdo rje phur pa bka' babs te bshad sgrub kyi nyams bzhes gtso bor mdzad pa yin/ gu ru nyid kyis bal yul yang le shod du yang dag mar me dgu ba'i dkyil 'khor phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i bar gcod kyang yi dam lhag pa'i lha 'di yi sgo nas 'dul bar mdzad/ gzhan yang rgya gar tsan dan kyi nags la mu stegs kyi gnas rten bcas pa la gu ru nyid kyis phur pa btabs pas mu stegs nags tshal dang bcas pa thal bar bsregs/ slar yang tsan dan gyi nags sngar bas legs par gyur/ bi ma mi tras chu bo gang gā la mu stegs kyi grerdzogs byed pa'i klu gnas pa la phur pa btab pas klu tshar dusader dam can sde gsum gyi srog snying phul bcad
༄tshi/ /nas gang gā yan lag du chad de lam dod pa blangs/ bal bo shri la mañdzas mkhar gong brag brag nas tsam du phye mar byas nas la btab pas the'u rang gnas pa btul/ gu ru nyid kyi rnam thar yang spyir sindha rgya mtshor padma la brdzus te 'khrungs tshul gsungs na'ang/ phur pa 'bum nag gi rgyud du ma las 'khrungs tshul bshad cing gdul bya'i don tu zhing khams rgya mtshor sprul pa'i zlos gar sgyur ba mdzad pa'i mtha' gcig tu bzung ba ga la nus/ bod yul 'dir dar tshul yang 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi thugs dam bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i dus su bod kyi lha srin gdug pa can rnams kyi bar chod brtsom par 'dul ba'i ched du rgya gar gu ru padma spyan drangs nas dpal gyi bsam yas sa chog nas bzung rab tu gnas pa'i bar gegs med du grub pa mdzad/ rje 'bangs rnams la spyir gsang sngags kyi chos mang du gsungs/ khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i dbang dang gdam ngag gnang ba na mnga' bdag rgyal po/ jo mo mtsho rgyal/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ shud pu dpal seng / mchims shākya pra bha/ cog ro bza'/ ngam 'dre a ba ro pa le/ mkhon klu dbang / rong ban yon tan rin chen rnams la gnang ba ni/ phur pa rgyal po lugs/ sna nam lugs/ shud pu lugs/ mchims lugs/ lcam
lugs / ngam 'bre lugs/ mkhon chosaring gnyisaka rgyun ma chad pa salugs lugs/ rong zom sna nam lugs dang rong lugs cig kyang kha gcig rong ban yon ga rin chen desaslob dpon chen po dngosal thug dgung lo ni brgya bzhes/ de'i srasarin chen tshul khrims lo phyed nyisabargyar bzhugs zer/ de'i srasarong zom panyu ta chosakyi bzang po yin/ lugs sogs la dgyes pa'i rgyud lugs bco brgyad tsam byung bar grags shong / khyad par jo mo mtsho rgyal la phrin las phur pa'i bka' babs te/ mon kha seng ge rdzong ne ring du phur pa sgrub pa'i zhag gcig nas sgrub rtags klong du gyur te phur pa thams cad bzhad cing 'khrab pa dang 'od 'phro ba byung ba'i jo mo'i dgongs pa la ma mo 'grub na khrag zor 'phen/ gshin rje 'grub na 'khor lo bskor/ phur pa 'grub na gdab las bya ba yin kyang kho mo la dgra med/ 'on kyang pha mes kyi srog 'phrog pa'i za 'dre la gdab par bya'o dgongs nas phur pa bsgril nas/ phur pa de nam mkha' la song bas pha yul sgrags kyi khang pa'i ltag na 'dre gnas pa'i skyer phung gcig yod pa thal bar tshig za 'dre bsgral mchims phu'i nags la me phre(ra bar phur pa btabs pas me shi mal la nags tshal rgyas/ chu bo rir bdud kyi mtha' bdun bya rog tu brdzus nas byung bar phur pa gdengs pas bya rog sa la lhung ste bsgral ba sogs grub mtshan mang du byung bar gsung / mchims shākya pra bhas yar lung gad pa'i phug tu grub mtshan brnyes pa dang /
༄tshi/ /shud bu dpal seng gis 'u shang rdo yi brag la phur pa gdab pa dang / rdo rje bdud 'joms kyis has po ri la me shor nas phur ba btabs pas me bsad/ mkhar chen mtsho rgyal gyi ming po dpal gyi dbang phyug gis spyang ki la phur pa btab pas drongs pa la sogs gu ru nyid kyi rjes 'jug rig 'dzin grub thob rnams kyis sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan dngos su bstan pa ni brjod kyis mi lang / gzhan yang byang gter phur pa dril sgrub lo rgyus las/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la mnga' bdag rgyal pos zhus pa/ kyai slob dpon chen po lags/ gu ru nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku la 'jigs pa mi mnga' zhing /bar du gcod pa gang gis mi tshugs pa la/ dus rtag tu lcags kyi phur pa 'di dang mi 'bral ba ji ltar lags/ zhes zhus pas ma hā gu rus bka' stsal pa/ mnga' bdag rgyal po 'di la don chen po yod ste rgyas par bshad na bsam gyis mi khyab/ bsdu na bar chad 'dul ba'i don kho na lags/ bdag la bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa med kyang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dang gdul bya 'dul ba'i phrin las mthar 'don pa la bar gcod yod pas bsgral bar bya'o/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na gsang sngags spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang / chos skyong ba'i rgyal po la man ngag 'di med na bar chad kyi dbang du 'gyur bas sras dang gdung rgyud phyi ma'i don du
'di la nan tan mdzod cig ces gsungs pas yang rgyal pos zhus pa/ kyai slob dpon chen po lags/ de lta bu'i phur pa lam gyi gang zag la zhin tu gal che bar mchis pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i don du rgyu bsog cing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon gyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po nyid kyi zhus pa ltar padma bdag gi phur pa rdzas kyi mtshon cha mang po bsags cing byin gyis rlabs nas/ bdag gi sgrub gnas phal cher du sbas gnas yod/ khyad par bod kyi mgar bas bzos pa'i lcags phur brgya rtsa gcig mon mgar ba dpal brtsegs kyis bzos pa'i lcags phur brgya rtsa gcig dur khrod rngams pa sgra sgrogs su rigs ngan gyi bzo bos sgrub pa'i seng phur brgya rtsa gcig /rgya nag bzo bos shing dza la nag po la/ bzos pa'i phur pa brgya rtsa gcig gdong rnams bsam yas mchims phu/ lho brag kho masang / spa gro stag tshang / bum thang seng ge rdzong / yar lung shel brag sgrags kyi yang rdzong ste gro brag dkar/ zang zang lha brag sogs bsgrub gnas phal cher du khyad par gter du sbas yod pas ma 'ongs pa na da lta'i rje 'bangs rnams smon lam gyi stobs kyis sprul sku gter ston re rer gyur nas/ 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /slar yang o rgyan nyid srin yul du phebs skabs bod kyi rje 'bangs rnams kyis gung thang la thog tu pheb skyel
༄༅/ /mdzad / khyad par jo mo mtsho rgyal dang / ngam 'bre sa we cog ro gsum gyis zhabs phyir 'bring bar zhus pas gu ru'i zhal nas nga gnam la bya ltar 'phur nas 'gro na khyed rnams yong ngam/ nga sa la bye'u /byi /ltar 'dzul nas 'gro na khyed kyis yong ngam/ chu la nya ltar 'phyo na khyed kyis yong ngam gsungs pas/ 'o na bdag gsum thugs bcud byung ba'i dbang dang gdams ngag zhu zhus pas/ zhal gyis bzhes nas de ma thag hūṃ hūṃ gsungs pas rdo rje phur pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsum du sprul ste bar snang la bstan nas khyod rnams dbang lha la zhu'am slob dpon la zhu gsungs pas jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis lha slob dpon gyi ye shes kyi rol pa yin pas dbang slob dpon la zhu zhus/ lcogs ro bzas dbang yi dam lha las thob na ya mtshan che/ snyam nas lha la zhu zer/ ngam 'dres slob dpon gyi thugs dang bstun pa zhus pas slob dpon gyi saṃ ha ra na hūṃ/zhes gsungs nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor thugs gar bsdus nas lcogs ro gza' la dbang bskur ba po med par lus/ mtsho rgyal dang ngam 'dre gnyis la dbang bzhi rdzogs par gnang / gzhan la ma gnang ba'i gdams ngag zab bsdus rnams gong phug nas bton nas jo mo mtsho rgyal la gnang / 'di nyid chig rgyud du byas na byin rlabs che bas khyod kyi ngam 'dre la shod gsungs/ jo mos ngam 'dre la gnang / phyis lcogs ro
gza' la gnang ba'i lcogs ro gza' ba'i lugs la phur pa lcam lugs su grags pa drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag zhes lha rje gnubs chung du rje btsun mi la'i mthu chen po 'di 'ang lcam lugs yin par gsungs ngam 'dre sa le'i slob ma'i gtso bo lang lab byang chub rdo rje yin ste/ ngam 'dre chu bo rir byon pa'i tshe lang lab sku gzhon nu'i skabs pha ma gnyis grongs/ khong nye tshan rnams kyis pha ma'i kha chems la ma nyan par khas chung gcig las ma sbyin par nor rdzas khang zhing thams cad blangs pas thugs shon tu pham par byung nas phyogs la byon pa'i chu bo rir ngam 'dre sa le dgung lo bzhi brgya phebs pa dang mjal/ 'o brgyal ba'i lo rgyus rnams zhus pas thugs kyai las can slob mar 'ong dgongs nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i phur pa'i gdams pa 'di gnang / lang lab kyis bsgrub pa byas pas yi dam lha yi zhal gzigs te/ dgra rnams tshar bcad mthu che ba'i grags thon kyang sbyin 'bras chung bas phongs bas ma bsangs te kho re na lug rdzi byed cing yod tsa na rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags gra ba mang pos bskor nas kho rer chos 'bor la phebs pa'i kho re btsan po la sogs pa'i chos bzhi zla ba gsum tsam btegs/ rwa lo de nyid sku bsod dang nus mthu che bas bod kyi che dgu bla ma slob dpon dge bshes kun gyis gar phebs kyi sar phyag dang zhe sa bkur sti 'bul dgos/ de
༄༅/ /ma phul na gshin rje gshed kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis skad cig la sgrol ba lags/ khong la zhe sa ma byas pas rje mar ba'i /pa'i /sras dar ma mdo sde la sogs sa gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' bcu gsum/gnyan lo tsā ba la sogs rang mnyam lo tsā ba bcu drug sogs mang po bsgral/ jo bo lang lab kyis phyag ma phul bas mi blun po zhig yin nam dgongs pa las slar mi rnams kyis khong phur pa la mkhas shing mthu nus che ba zhig yin yang longs spyod chung bas gzhan gyi lug ldi byed dgos pa lags byas pas/ khong nga rgyal kyi khong sbos pas nga la phyag mi byed par 'dug pas kho la do nub kyi tshe las med pa sgur sdod cig gsungs/ chos thun gcig grol ba dang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsad pa'i sbyor ba bzhi mdzad ste/ sbyin sreg gi skabs su rwa lo nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed skur gyur nas ling ga la lang lab 'gugs pa'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /jo po lang lab ni lug 'tsho ba las gzhan ci yang ma mdzad/ de nas rwa lo nyid kyi 'gugs gzhugs dang po'i tshe rdo rje gzhon nu dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor gyi gtsang phur rnams char du phab pas tho phyi'i grwa ba rnams smas/'gugs gzhugs bar ma la za gsod khro bcu'i gtsang phur rnams char du phab pas 'khor gyi grwa pa rnams bros dgos byung / 'gugs gzhugs tha ma'i tshe nam mkha' me dang 'ur sgras gang bas der rwa los steng du
gzigs pas/ gnam lcags las grub pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu ri do chad tsam sku stod khro bo la sku smad phur pa'i dbal du yod pa thugs ka nas phur pa bsgril ba/ zhal nas hūṃ phaṭa sgra sgrogs pa zhig dbu gtsug tu bab la khad gzab gzab rngams rngams 'cha' 'cha' ltar 'dug pa gzigs pas thugs sngangs shing skrags de nyid du bzod par gsol/ lang lab la gus btud byed par dam bcas pas cho 'phrul rnams rang zhir song /nang bar lang lab spyan drangs nas yi dam rtags mngon sum thon pa'i skyes bu ngo mtshar che gsungs sri zhu dang 'bul ba rgya cher mdzad pas skye bo rnams kyis gshin rje'i mkhan po phur pa la rdugs bya ba'i gtam de rgya cher grags par gyur ro/ /jo bo lang lab la slob ma'i mchog gyur bzhi dang / gzhan yang nus mthu can mang du byung ba yin/ de dag rgyud lugs mang tsam byung ba yin/ sang gter ma'i phyogs la yer pa lugs rta mgrin chen posadangosasu bstan pa grub thob 'dar phya ru pasader sgrub phur pa zhig gter nas bton sapaṇa dang gnasakhang ga:ga tu'ajom skabasazhal 'chosapasasngags mnan gsungs pasabrag la phur pa tham tham brgyab slar shā byed dga' bo btul phur pa de rim gyisagyar nas da lta se ra'i phur pa de yin gsungs/ phur pa mkhon lugs ni 'khon srung bas/ slob dpon padma la zhus nas rim par brgyud de deng sang sa phur du grags pa 'di yin la/ lugs srol de las khyad par du gyur pa phur pa jo mo lugs 37 rgyan padma'i gong khug
༄tshi/ /mar grags pa 'di ni byang zang zang lha brag gi shar phyogs brag phug hoX khung 'dra ba'i nang du bse sgrom smug po'i nang du rgyal po nyid la dgos pa'i chos tshangs par yod/ khyad par du gyur pa rdo rje phur pa gong khug mar grags pa de dang mnyam du padma bdag gis seng ge rdzongs su bsgrub pa'i nyams rtags tshad du phyin pa'i bsnyen phur gcig dang mon mgar dpal brtsegs kyis lcags sna bdun la brdungs pa'i bal yul yangale shod du bsgrub pa'i phur pa srid gsum bdud 'dul zhes bya ba dang / rgya gar ha shang ya khrod pa'i mgar bas brdungs pa stag tshangs se ge'i bsam 'grub tu dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i sras mchog nyi ma dang / rgya nag ha shang ya na'i shing dza la nag po la bzos pa'i chu bo rir rdo rje phur pa'i zhal gzigs pa'i phur pa/ jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis bsnyen phur seng ldeng la bzos pa'i chu bo rir bdud kyi mtha' bdun bya rog tu brdzus nas byung ba btul ba'i phur pa/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi bsnyen phur ge sar khrom gyi yul gyi shing drag po tsher lag can la bzos pa'i has po ri la me shor ba bsad pa'i phur pa dang / bsnyen phur gcig dang las phur gcig bcas sbas zhes gsungs pa'i sprul sku rig 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis gter nas spyan drangs pa'i byang gter phur pa'i bskor la lha khra dang / lha nag lha 'dus gsum ste/ lha khra zhes pa lho gser
mdzod nas byon pa'i phur pa che mchog la ngos 'dzin te gtso 'khor rnams kyi sku mdog sna tshogs su yod pas lha khra zhes bya/ lha nag zhes gtso 'khor rnams kyi sku mdog nag por yod pas lha nag zer/ 'di ni rdo rje phur pa mchog gi rgyud bi to ta ma 'bum sde'i yang snying gsang ba drag sngags su sdebs pa/ byang lcags mdzod nag po nas byon pa'i phur pa drag sngags zhes ñtsarsha rgyan padma'i skyurdzong khug mar grags pa 'di yin la/ lha 'dus ni phur pa dril sgrub tu grags pa 'di yin lags/ gter ston rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid kyang rdo rje phur pa'i bka' bab pa yin la/ de yang snyan brgyud drug gi tho byang las/ pha ni brtul zhugs bzang spyod rdo rje phur pa'i sprul ba slob dpon bdud 'dul dpal rigs/ /ma ni mkha' 'gro dbang phyug ma/ /rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi/ /ting 'dzin ngang du sbyor ba las/ /las dang thugs rje smon lam 'dzom/ /zhes dang ewa rgyan gling pa'i zab gter las/ thugs sprul rbesnad me glang lor cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshesabacur sku bltams/ dgung lo bcu gnyisapa'i dusadabu gtsug tu rtsa ba spu dkar rtse mo'i rgod sgra'i rnam pa gsum dang nyer bzhi dusalnga skyes/ dgung lo don gnyisabar 'gro rnams smin grol la bkod sprul sku bzang po grags pa'i kha byang dang / ri bo bkra bzang nasagater gyi lde mig 'dzeng rdo dkar po sogs rnyed pa la brten/ gnas de'i nub byang phyogs byang zang zang lha brag gi sked brag ri dug sprul spung 'dra nas mdzod lnga'i gter rnams me rta lor lug zla'i tshesabazhi'i srod la spyan drangasaso kyi ldem 'phru can/
༄tshi/ /zhes khi/ rgyan nyid kyi sprul pa yin par lung bstan cing / gter chen bzhes pa'i lo rgyus kyang gsol 'debs brda' chen ma las/ dus dang gza' skar 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ sra ba'i brag la yangs pa'i sgo mo phye/ bka' bzhin bsgrub na ci bsam 'grub pa'i rtags/ zhes sogs 'ordzo rgyus rgyas pa 'dir yi ge mang dogs ma bris pas rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar dang spyi 'ching rnams su gzigs shog de ltar rig 'dzin chen po nyid las byung ba'i dbang lung man ngag gi chu bo bab tshul kyang sras brgyud slob brgyud gnyis su yod pa las sras brgyud ni gter ston chen po'i dgung lo drug pa la rig 'dzin chen po'i drung du dgongs pa zang thal gyi dbang khrid rnams gsan/ bkra bzang du sgrub pa lo lnga tsam mdzad pas rdzogs pa chen po'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur/ khyad par du byang lcagasamadzod kyi bdag por lung bstan/ 2rdo rje dpal ba ni rig 'dzin chen po'i lcam mo'i srasayin sku sras rnam rgyal maskyusten krerdzo nas rigs sngags 'chang ba rdo rje rdo rje mgon po ni chu tshugs phu'i dgon pa sne mo lung zhesapa'i nye char du 'khrungs/ de nyid kyi sku tsha ngag dbang grags pa yin mgon po la brgyud tshul dang slob brgyud ni sangs rgyas byams bzang nas/ se ston nyi ma bzang po la brgyud pa sogs byung ba kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po lnga ba chen po la dbang gi chu bo gnyis 'dus su babs pa yin la/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa 'di dag kyang phrin las phur pa'i sgrub mtshan tpū nang gsang gsum tshad du phyin pa so
so'i rnam thar du gsal zhing rgyal dbang mchog gi chog 'khrigs phur ba'i rig 'dzin bskul pa/ gter ston rig 'dzin yab yum gyis/ zang zang ri bo'i rtse mo la/ /ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci/ /gsang sngags shākya bzang po yis/ /yol mo gangs kyi ra ba rtswa /ji ltar rtags : legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje yis/ 'bras ljongs gnas sgo 'byed dus su/ /ji ltar rtags : chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis/gtsang chab sngon mo gyen bzlog tshegiX ji ltar : zhes gsungs/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa de dag las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos nyams su len pa la/ gzhung de nyid las/ o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyis/ /phur pa bi to ta ma la/ /'bum sde'i rgyud la blo sbyangs nas/ /g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug tu/ /mi lo bcu gnyis bar du bsgrubaltoX de yi phrin las 'di kho na'o/ /phun sum tshogs pa drug ldan pa'i/ /sngon 'gro'i rim pa tshul bzhin bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dang po phun sum lhangogs pa drug gi sgo nas bsgrub pa'i gzhi bzung dgos pa ni/ snga 'gyur spyi dang gzhung mang por gsal ba ltar yin lags/ 'di nyid nyams su len pa'i gang zag gis rdo rje slob dpon mtshan phun sum tshogs pa lnga yo byad yang zob pa tsam gyisami chog ste dbang sto: pa dang 'brel bsagrub gnyisakyi 'byung gnas spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig la 'bad dgos/ nyid dang ldan pa'i drung du 'di nyid kyi dbang lung man ngag rnams
༄tshi/ /legs par nos nas/ rgyud las gsung pa ltar drag po'i gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'am/ yid dang mthun pa zhig tu dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus sman gtor rakta dam can spyi sgos kyi mchod sgrub kyi gtor ma sogs mthong rgyud phyag len ltar bshams la stan bde ba la 'dug ste byang chub mchog tu phyogs te rang rgyud la brtags nas/ 'jig rten chosabargyad sogs tshe 'di'i phun tshogs don chen gnyer dngaphyi ma'i mtho tsam dang / bde ba cig zhi bde don du gnyer ba'i kun slong 'dug na 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang 'khor ba yid la bsam nas byams dang snying rje byang chub smon pa'i sems mar gyur sems can thamasacad kyi don du bdag nyid sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid kyi rnal 'byor dang du blangs par bya'o snyam pa 'jug pa'i kun slong gsal ba gal che gsungs/ sems bskyed pa'i ngang nas 'khor 'das kyi mtshams dbye'i rol mo bya/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs lan gsum gyi skabs/ rang gi spyi bor padma nyi zla'i gdan la o rgyan chen po padma 'byung gnas la rtsa rgyud rig 'dzin rgya mtshos ba〉rdzor ba spyan drangs nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bya/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams rang la bstim nas rang nyid yi dam gyi lha gsal nas gnas yo byin gyis rlabs pa ni sam bha ra sogs gzungs sngags brjod pa'i mthus snod bcud thams cad mchod pa'i bye brag tu 'gyur zhing / dge 3)ra 'bum 'gyur du 'phel bar rgyud las gsungs4༷༷ 'byung pa rim brtsegs gzhal yas khang dang bcas
pa bskyed dgos par/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas e las nam mkha' mthing nag rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba/ gru gsum chos kyi 'byung gnas gdal khyab yangs pa chen po'i klong du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang ku gzhu'i dbyibs can/ de steng ra las rakta'i rgya mtsho zlum po/ de'i steng du sum̐ las zhing chen sa gzhi gru bzhi pa/ de'i steng spu las rus pa'i ri rab/ de'i steng raṃ bhrūṃ las me 'od kha dog lnga ldan gyi dbus su drag po'i pho brang mtshan nyid tshang bar tshig rjes don dran gyi bsgom pa'i nang du mchod pa'i bye brag rnams bhrūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'am/ thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba bsgom kyang rung ste/ de lta bu'i snod kyi nang du so so'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa 'od du zhu ba'am/ yang na tshig don ltar oX zhu ba las byung ba'i phyi nang gi mchod pa lha rdzas las grub pa'i nam mkha'i khams rab 'byams gang bar mos nas/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta zhes sogs sngags brjod pas phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba rab 'byams dpal chen phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs pa la so so'i sngags kyis mchod par bsam/ na mo ratna tra yā ya sogs gzungs brjod pa'i mthus phung po'i sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa bsnyen bskur dpag tu med par 'gyur bar gsungs/ dngos su 'byor dang sogs tshig rjes don
༄༅/ /dran dang / skyabs su 'gro ba ni mdun gyi nam mkha' o rgyan rdo rje 'chang la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho/ khyad par du dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams mngon sum lta bur mos nas/ bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa srid pa las bsgral phyir gzhung ltar skyabs sems dam bca' rigs lnga'i sdom bzung tshad med bzhi rnams legs par song nas skyabs yul rang la stim/ rang nyid skad cig gis che mchog he ru ka dpal zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba ñtsa yi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i oX dkar po la a laṃ ka klas bskor bar mos la a li ka li rten 'brel snying po rnams bzlas pas lce steng gi sngags phreng rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams la sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ byin rlabs rnams 'od zer kha dog lnga dang oX āXhūṃ dang a lam̐ ka laṃ rten 'brel snying po'i rnam par spyan drangs nas snyu steng gi yig 'bru rnams la thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros lha mi drang srong bram ze ngag nus pa la dbang ba rnams kyi ngag gi nus pa thams cad bkug nas sngags phreng rnams la thim pas ngag nus pa dang ldan par 'gyur/ 'phreng ba byin rlabs bsnyen bsgrub phyi ltar lag g.yas zla ba g.yon nyi ma bsams pa'i bar du phreng ba
bzung la mdud 'dzin yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas la mnyes mchod 'bul/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams 'dus nas mdud 'dzin lhar gsal ba la thim pas 'od du zhu nas phreng ba la thim par bsam/ rdo rje yar gyi rwa lnga rigs lnga mar gyi rwa lnga yum lngar gsal ba'i lte ba la mkha' gsang byang sems su 'khyil pa las gong ltar 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rjer gyur par mos/ dril yum las yum lngar gsal ba'i mkha' gsang du yab lnga'i rdo rjes bsnun pa'i byang sems las 'phros 'dus yum lnga dril bu dang / yab lnga dril rtse'i rdo rjer gyur par mos/ thod rnga byin rlabs la/ rnga kun bzang yum gyi mkha' gsang du/ rnga lcags kun bzang yab kyi gsang rdor sbyar ba'i byang sems chos nyid rang sgra sgrogs pas stong gsum mkha' mnyam thams cad chos sgras gang bar mos/ phur pa rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i sbyor mtshams nas mdun du hūṃ sngon 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur ba'i gnam lcags las grub pa'i sras mchog badzra kī la ya sku stod khro bo la sku smad zur gsum mgar gyi so mal ston ma thag pa lta bur/ bza' btung rnams 'dod yon gyi lha mo'i rang bzhin du mos/ rang nyid yi dam kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dus gsum bde gshegs rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar mos nas yan lag bcu pa bya/
༄tshi/ /sngon gtor raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum gyis bsregs gtor bkrus oX āXhūṃ gis byin gyis rlabs la/ rang nyid yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos gdon bgegs rnams rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bskrad par mos/ yang dag don gyi bka' bsgo dang / sum bha ni sogs hūṃ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ phyi mtshams rgyal chen sde bzhi la bcol ba ni/ rang nyid yi dam gsal ba'i thugs ka nas raṃ yaṃ khaṃ las me rlung chus bsregs gtor bkrus/ oX āXhūṃ gsum gyis spyi ltar byin gyis rlabs te/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i ngang las thugs ka nas hūṃ dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi 'phros pas sgrub khang gi tpū yi phyogs bzhir gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus rgyal po chen po sde bzhir bskyed pa ni de yang shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin pa dri za'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po ser po ral gri 'dzin pa grul bum gyis bskor ba/ nub tu rgyal po spyan mi bzang dmar po mchod rten dang sbrul zhag 'dzin pa 'bor klu dbang gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang du rgyal po rnam thos ljang ku rgyal mtshan dang ne'u le 'dzin pa 'bor gnod sbyin gyis bskor ba/ de rnams kyi thugs ka rang rang gi sku mdog dang mthun pa'i hūṃ yig gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi phyogs bzhi nas rgyal chen sde bzhi'i ye shes pa 'bor dang bcas
pa spyan drangs nas so sor stim par mchod bstod phrin bcol rnams bya/ de ni phyi mtshams rgyal chen bzhi la bcol ba'o/ /de yang bsnyen bsgrub sogs la sgo drung dang phyogs bzhi sogs su tho brtsegs so sor spyan 'dren mchod bstod bya/ sgrub pa ma grol bar brtan bzhugs dang phrin bcol sogs skabs thob tu shes par bya/ de yang gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi yul nas bdud kyi rgyal po dga' rab dbang phyug dang / btsun mo padma'i phreng ba/ blon po 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi/ bdud phran bye ba sa ya sogs kyis sems can nyon mongs pa shas che ba rnams log pa'i lam du 'khrid pa la dpal chen pos sprul pa bskyed nas bdud rgyal dga' rab dbang phyug 'dul byed du dpal rdo rje gzhon nu dang / btsun mo padma'i phreng ba 'dul byed yum 'bor lo rgyas 'debs ma sprul/ blon po 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi 'dul bar rgyal po bzhi sprul pa bskyed pa yin pas rgyal chen sde bzhi mchod thabs la brtson dgos pa yang de yin lags/ rgyas par 'dod na bsgrub chen gyi gzhung rnams su gzigs shig /phyi mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūṃ rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su/ zhes brjod pas zhe sdang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas hūṃ phaṭa kyi sgra dang bcas gdon bgegs rnams phyir bskrad/ slar yang tshur 'dus pas phyogs mtshams steng 'og rnams su
༄༅/ /'jig rten dregs pa brdzis pa'i steng du khro bo bcu sku mdog mthing nag mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa/ sku las bskal ba'i me dpung 'bar zhing mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshubs ma'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad gtams par bsgom pa'i khro bo de rnams kyi zhal nas/ hūṃ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni/ zhes sogs kyis gdon bgegs rnams la bka' bsgo bar bsams nas rdo rje sder mo'i sngags brjod/ hūṃ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs4༷༷ sogs nyu bzhi'i sngags kyis phyi mtshams bcad pa'o/ bar mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūṃ nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ zhes sogs brjod pas nga nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i ngang nas khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can thams cad rgyu ma rig pa las bskyed pa'i dug lnga dug gsum gyi kun slong gis lus ngag yid gsum mi dge ba bcu spyad pa las 'khor ba las bsgral ma nus pa rnams la snying rje tshad med pa skyes nas de dag 'bor ba las bsgral phyir/ phyir thugs ka nas sprul pa'i khro bo sku stod khro bo la sku smad phur pa'i dbyibs can gnam lcags las grub pa mgar gyi so mal nas drang ma thag lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas khams gsum sems can gyi lus kyi mi dge ba bsgral nas lus sprul pa'i skur gyur/ de bzhin du ngag gi mi dge ba bsgral nas ngag longs skur gyur/ yang yid kyi mi dge ba bsgral nas
yid chos skur gyur/ de ltar bsgral ba la brten nas sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum sku gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i stong gsum dag pa ye shes kyi rang bzhin la bgegs log 'dren ma dag pa'i ming yang med pa ni/ bar mtshams bcad pa'o/ gsang mtshams bcad pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i de dag gi sne la phur ba grangs med pa spros nas steng thams cad gur dang 'og thams cad phur pa'i sa gzhi phyogs mtshams thams cad phur pa'i ra bar gtam par mos/ de yang phur pa thams cad gnam lcags las grub pa'i rang 'dra'i phur pa grangs med pa 'phro bar bsgom pa ni gsang mtshams bcad pa'o/ /khro bo'i zhal rnams phyir gzigs nas/ /mtshon cha mang pos dgra bgegs sgrol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad khro bos gtam pa'i sku las mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshubs pa me dpung kha dog lnga ldan je cher 'bar bar bsam/ rgyas par spro na gsang sngags lam rim ltar srung gabor drug gi bsgom tshul rig 'dzin padma phrin las kyi mdzad pa'i yang yig ltar bsgom kyang mchog tu gyur/ oX badzra sa ma ya dza zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bcas bshags yul dkyil 'bor gyi lha tshogs la phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba zhi khro rnams kyis bskor ba/ bsrung 'bor nang du skad cig
༄tshi/ /spyan drangs la/ /dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus dgongs su gsol/ /zhes sogs kyis bdag gzhan gyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib gnong 'gyod drag pos bshags pa'i lha tshogs de rnams thugs rgyud mnyes te/ sku gsung thugs kyi gnas las 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung nas bdag la snum pas sdig sgrib thams cad nyi ma shar ba'i mun pa ltar sang sang dag pa'i rang lus lha yi rang bzhin shel sgong dri ma med pa ltar gyur par bsam la/ brda sgo dbye ba ni/ lag pa'i sor mo nang sdom su bsnol/ hūṃ bde gshegs rgyal ba'i pho brang sogs brjod nas pra be sha ya'i mtshams su phyag rgya dkrol nas rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dkyil 'bor gyi phyogs bzhi'i sgo bzhi dbye bas/ snang srid zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du dbye nas lhun grub tu gnas pa rang ngo rang shes su thag chod par bsam/ brda' phyag 'tshal ba nigiX thal mo sbyar la/ hūṃ yang dag gsang ba'i sogs brjod pas rang ngo rang shes la nges shes bskyed nas de nyid ston pa'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal bar mos/ dam bca' ba ni/ hūṃ lhag pa'i lha khyod sogs brjod nas gnas lugs rang ngo rang shes de las dus nam yang mi 'da' bar dam bca'/ byin dbab pa ni/ a la la ho zhes sogs brjod pa'i rnga yab padma 'od nas rig 'dzin chen po padma 'byung gnas la rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin dpa' bo
mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyang dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs nas bdag dang sgrub rdzas gnas khang rnams la thim pas gzi byin dang ldan par bsam/ mchod rdzas byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ thams cad ye shes cho 'phrul sogs sngags bcas brjod pas phyi nang mchod rdzas rnams rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams so so'i ming yig dang po/ dhuXpuX.aXghaXneshaX ༷༷rnams yongs su gyur pa las dhu pe dkar mos spos khang 'dzin pa/ puṣṭi ser mos me tog 'dzin pa/ ā lo ke dmar pos mar me 'dzin pa/ ghandhe ljang mos dril bu 'dzin pa/ nai wi tya dmar mos zhal zas 'dzin pa/ shabha sngon mos rol mo 'dzin pa sogs mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams gang bar bsam/ sman gtor rakta gsum gyi steng du rang nyid yi dam du gsal thugs ka nas re 'phros dngos 'dzin bag chags rnams mes bsregs/ yaṃ 'phros rlung gis gtor khaṃ 'phros dngos 'dzin rnams chus bkrus/ bdud rtsi byin gyisarlabasapa ni/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas bhrūṃ dkar po zhig byung ba bdud rtsi'i snod la thim pas phyi bhanta la nang gzhal yas khang gsal ba'i dbus su 'bor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud zlum pos bskor ba'i lte bar byang sems/ shar rtsibs la dri chen/ lhor me sa te sha
༄༅/ /chen / nub padma rakta/ byang du dri chu rnams bsam dngos bstan du/ bdud rtsi lnga las ma bshad kyang bdud rtsi byin rlabs phal cher du sha lnga yang bshad pas spro na rang lugs/ dbus su seng ge'i sha/ shar du glang po che'i sha/ 3tor rta yi sha/ nub tu rma bya'i sha/ byang du khyung gi sha rnams bsam /lnga po bam ril byed na mgo bo g.yasadang kha nang du bstan pa sil bul byed pa yang rung / rdzasarnams so so'i mdog can nam gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar na rigs lnga so so'i mdog can du byed pa'ang yod/ de dag so so'i rigs kyi rigs lnga yab yum bskyed pa la/ dbus su nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ smyu/ shar du zla ba'i gdan la oX liṃ/ lhor rin po che'i gdan la swā muṃ/ nub tu padma'i gdan la a byaṃ/ byang du e dmar ser gyi gdan la ha rta de rnams las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dbus su mi bskyod pa yab yum/ shar du rnam snang yab yum/ lhor rin 'byung yab yum/ nub tu snang mtha' yab yum/ byang du don grub yab yum/ rig lnga yab lnga'i gsang ba rdo rje rtse lngar gyur pa'i nang du zla ba la oX dkar po'i rtse mo'i bu ga'i nang phaṭa sngon po mgo phyir bstan pa/ yum lnga'i mkha' gsang padma 'dab brgyad dmar po'i lte bar e gru gsum rtsa yi rtse mo la thig le dmar po rgya mtshal btsag pa lta bu yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ phyag rgya bzhi'i las sbyor ba mdzad pas sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar po char ltar bab ste/ bdud rtsi'i snod
mer gyis khengs pa'i steng du oX dkar po zhig ye re gnas par bsam/ rang lha gsal ba'i lag g.yas g.yon gyi sor mo bcu rigs lnga yab yum du gyur pa snyoms 'jug gi byang sems bab pa bhan dha'i bdud rtsir 'dres par mos lag pa sor mo nang du nang sdems su bsnol ba'i phyag rgya bdud rtsi la bstan la bdud rtsi g.yas bskor du dkrug cing phyar ba dang / lag g.yas g.yon gyi mtheb srin bdud rtsi la reg pa'i tshe mtheb srin gyi steng nyi zla'i gdan la rta mgrin dmar po g.yas padma/ g.yon sdigs mdzub can/ /de'i mdun tu mi pham ma dkar mo lcags kyu thogs pa/ g.yas na khro gnyer ma ser mo zhags pa thogs pa/ rgyab na ral gcig ma dmar mo lcags sgrog thogs pa/ g.yon na ro langs ma ljang ku dril bu thogs par bsam/ /yang de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas phyi snod 'khor bcas dwangs ma'i bcud thams cad bsdus nas bdud rtsi la thim pas rta mgrin gsang ba'i yum bzhi dang sbyor ba mdzad pa'i byang sems babs pas kyang bdud rtsi dang 'dres pa'i dkar mer gyis khengs pa dang / rta mgrin gyi yum bzhi yang rjes chags mer gyis zhu nas thim/ rta mgrin gyi sku lte ba man chad kyang bdud rtsi dang gnyis med du gyur/ sku stod khro bor lam mer bzhugs pa dang bdud rtsi bsrung ma dang dngos grub kyi lha yi ngo bor mos/ de nas bsang gtor bya ba ni/ /g.yas kyi mtheb
༄༅/ /srin bdud rtsi rang la reg pas dam tshig nyams grib thams cad dag par bsam/ mtheb srin g.yon skor dam rdzas kyi ma dag pa'i skyon sbyangs/ g.yas mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi g.yas skor du gtor bas zegs ma re re la gnod sbyin sngo nag mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa 'phros/ dgra bgegs dam sri dmar po gdug pa can rnams la phog pas dpag tshad mang por phyir bskrad/ khro bo de rnams tshur 'dus pas phyogs mtshams thams cad khro bo'i gur du gtams par mos/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa 'di bzhin phur pa drag sngags kyi phrin las kyi gzhung ltar bris pa yin/ so so'i skabs thog gi drag sngags rnams dril bu sgrub phrin las khrag 'thung rol par ma gsal bar 'dir yang ma bkod lags/ dmigs pa 'di rnams bdud rtsi byin rlabs phal cher la gal che bar 'dug pas/ las byang gi bdud rtsi byin rlabs sngags skabs dmigs pa gsal btab na 'dra bsam kyang / mkhyen ldan rnams kyis dpyad par 'tshal bar zhu zhing / gtor ma byin rlabs kyi/ kha ta rong zom chen posakha nam mkha' kha ba gzhi de gang bar gtor ma bsham pa'i don yin par gsungs zhesadabang bskur rin chen bum bzang stad li sngags mdzad pas bhrūṃ yig 'od du zhu ba las gtor snod dur khrod gyi khog par gtor rdzas zhing bcu ru tra bsgral ba'i snying khrag sha rus chu ser lnga lnga'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi
rang rtsal las gzugs kyi lha mo dkar mo me long 'dzin pa/ sgra yi lha mo sngon mo pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ /dri yi lha mo ser mo spos khang 'dzin pa/ /ro yi lha mo dmar mo zhal zas sna tshogs gang ba'i gzhong pa 'dzin pa/ reg bya'i lha mo ljang gu na bza' pañtsa laṃ ka gong ba rdo rje rgya gram mtshan pa dang / chos kyi lha mo dharma ka glegs bam bsnams pa de/ de dag kyang nam mkha' gang bar bsam/ gtor ma shes pa sum ldan las mchod rdzas su shes skabs yin lags/ gzhan yang bsgrub gtor dang bzlog gtor lha gsal dgos skabs thebs su shes dgos/ rakta byin rlabs ni snod zhing bcu bsgral ba las byung ba'i bhanta yangs shong rgya che bar bcud ra yig dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las 'jig rten khams kyi dmar ba'i rtsi bcud dwangs ma'i khrag thams cad bsdus pa'i rakta'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur pa dang / rakta g.yon tu dkrug cing rakta'i sngags mang du brjod/ gzhan yang phur pa che mchog las phyi ltar rakta'i rgya mtsho las/ nang ltar skye ba med par don gsang ba yum gyi thig ler gyur zhes gsungs pa'i bka' brgyad ltar na/ ra las lha mo rdo rje sgeg mo'i mkha' gsang nas rakta bab pas rakta'i rgya mtshor rba klong 'khrugs par gyur/ rakta'i sngags brjod de lha mo yang rakta la rim par bsam pa sogs gang bde gnang chog 'dra bsam/ tsha srid chosaskur dag byed/ de
༄7/ /nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum nas bzung las byang gi dkyusasku phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa las/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni/ /rdo rje khros pas rdo rje phur pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i chosaskad zhe sdang gcod/ zhes brjod pas/ rdo rje ni don dam pa chos kyi dbyings spros dang bral ba stong pa nyid zhes bya ba mi rtogs pa zhes bya ba ye nas ma bcos pa zhes bya ba/ gzhi rnal ma'i thog tu bzhag pas rdo rje'i lte ba ltar dbyibs zlum po rgya gar yang khyab/phyogs gang du yang ma lhung pa'o/ /gzhi yi ngang de las 'aspusar 'das gnyis ka 'byung bas rdo rje rwa lnga byung nas 'od du 'bar ba ltar/ ye shes lnga shar te da lta gyi snang ba 'di ma 'gags pa sna tshogs su snang ba yang snang ba'i dus su ngo bo stong par 'dug pas chos kyi dbyings yin/ rtsal snang ma 'gags par gsal le 'dug pa chos kyi sku yin/ stong pa dang gsal pa so sor phye yang dbyer med pa bde ba chen po yin no/ /don rang gi rig pa gsal le ba 'di ka rang lugs su ma bcos ma slad par gnas tshad bzhag /de yang bying zhing rmug pa yang ma yin/ /'gyu zhing 'phro ba yang ma yin/ /rtog med tu gsal le ba 'di ka chos kyi sku 'byung / ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa'i rdo rje zhes bya'o/ /khros pas zhe sdang gcod zhes pa ni rang gi rig pa gsal stong du ye re ba de'i ngang la ma yengs bar seng nge ba bzhag pa las khros pa zhes bya ste gang la'ang blo mi
'jug pa'o/ /zhe sdang gcod zhes pa 'di gong gi rig pa gsal stong du gnas pa'i dus na nyon mongs pa zhe sdang la sogs pa nyon mongs pa thams cad rgyun chad pa na/ zhe sdang gcod zhes bya ste rnam rtog thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /de ltar yun ring du bzhag pas rjes thob thams cad chos kyi skur 'char ro/ /de'i dus na ting 'dzin gzhan la rtsol ba med par 'grub pas 'di la nan tan byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ /mtshon chen sngon po 'bar ba'i ngang / /zhes brjod pas gong gi ting nge 'dzin de dag ni chos thams cad kyi snying po yin pas/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje phyogs ris med pa bskyed pas snying rje des rkyen byas chos sku'i dgongs pa dran te rig pa gsal snang ma 'gags pa bzhag pas ye shes kyi rtsal 'od lngar gsal ba'o/ /mtshon chen zhes pa rig pa gsal la rtog med dus na/ rnam rtog thams cad rtsa ba nas gcod pa mtshon chen zhes bya/ sngon po zhes bya ni dgongs pa de dang ldan na nam mkha' ltar 'gyur ba med pa'i don yin/ 'bar ba zhes pa ni rig pa rang snang so ma la ye shes lnga yi 'od gsal ba'o/ /gsum pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ nam mkha'i dkyil nas thig par shar/ zhes pa ni nam mkha'i ni mtha' dang bral ba'i dpes mtshon la/ rang gi rig pa rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba'i stong gsal bde ba chen po de las
༄tshi/ /snying rje shar ba'i thugs rje sprul pa'i skur 'byung bas rgyu'i yi ge hūṃ masang nag gcig lam gyi shar ba la thig pa shar zhes bya/ hūṃ de rig pa las shar cing rig pa'i ngo bo yin pas/ hūṃ dang rig pa dbye ba med pa'i ngang la bzhag pas rgyu yi hūṃ de 'byung ba lnga dang ye shes lnga 'char ba'i sa bon yin pas srog gi go ru shar ba dang / snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya/ /zhes brjod pas rgyu'i hūṃ mthing nag de las thig pa babs pa ltar phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ sum lam rnams/ mthing nag phaṭa las 'byung ba nam mkha'i klong / /zhes phaṭa mthing nag las nam mkha' rnam par dag pa gru gsum mthing nag phyogs brgyar brdal ba de yang ngo bo chos kyi sku kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' klong rnam par dag pa'i ngo bor gyur pas na 'bor ba dang mya ngan 'das pa'i cha thams cad las khyab cing 'bor 'das kyi chos thams cad chos sku skye med klong las shar cing / skye med du thim pa na nam mkha'/ /de yang kha dog mthing ka mi 'gyur ba'i don dang / /zur gsum ni rnam thar gyi sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa/ smon pa med pa gsum mtshon par byed lags/ /de lta bu'i nam mkha' mthing nag gru gsum gyi dbyibs can rgyar yang khyab pa'i tshad zhes bya ba med pa'i klong du rgyu'i yi ge hūṃ las phaṭa ljang nag gcig babs pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang nag gzhu 'od ma'i dbyibs can lte ba rdo rje rgya gram gyis
mtshan pa/ de yi klong du rgyu'i hūṃ las phaṭa/ dmar nag me yi dkyil 'bor gru gsum dmar po bskal pa dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba/ de'i steng rgyu'i hūṃ las hūṃ dmar gsal las chu'i dkyil 'khor mtshon don rakta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dbyibs zlum po/ de'i steng du sum̐ ser nag las zhing chen gyi sa gzhi ser nag gru gsum rgya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa de'i dbus su lam dkar po las keng rus ri rab chen po rab tu brjid cing lhun chags par bsgom pa ni 'byung ba rim brtsegs/ de yang yum lnga rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin nam mkha' dbyings phyug ma/ rlung dam tshig sgrol ma/ me gos dkar mo/ khrag ma ma kī /keng rus sangs rgyas spyan ma'i rang bzhin du shes dgos/ de steng e las smug nag 'od ltar shar/ snang srid ma lus phur pa'i gzhal yas khang / zhes pa ni ri rab kyi steng du oX lam smug nag las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las snang srid phur pa'i gzhal yas khang du gsal ba/ de yang ri rab la srid pa'i phur pa zhig btag pas stong gsum thams cad dbyibs phur pa la nang 'byung ba lnga'i steng du lha yi pho brang gzhal yas khang du gnas pa/ de yang smad zur gsum ngan song gi gnas bcu rgya mdud 'og ma la gling bzhi gling phran mar bcad nas/ ri rab kyi sked man chad de la 'dod khams kyi lha dang mi gnas/ lcim gzhog zur brgyad kyi
༄༅/ /smad la gzugs khams gnas rig bcu bdun/ lcim gzhogs zur brgyad kyi stod la gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi'i lha gnas/ rgya mdud gong ma la bde gshegs rgyal ba'i pho brang gzhal yas khang dkyil 'khor chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa yang rgyu'i hūṃ de las bhrūṃ smug nag gcig bab pa las de las 'od zer 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad 'od du zhu nas bhrūṃ la thim pas bhrūṃ bi sha'i sngags brjod pas bhrūṃ yig 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i rab 'jigs kyi dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang / de yang dbus su gru gsum mthing nag zla gam mu khyud zlum po dkar po/ gru chad bzhi ser ljang / phyi rim gru gsum brgyad mthing nag steng 'og gnyis pa'ang gru gsum mthing nag de yi phyi'i gra bzhi nas zhing chen smug po bzhi'i ka ba btsug pa/ rus sbal gyi ka gdan/ gza' chen po brgyad kyi ka gzhu/ lha chen tshangs pa ser pos gdung brgyad bsnol ba/ bdud bzhi bsgral ba'i gral 'phyam/ zhing bcu bsgral ba'i sha rus kyi mig tshag dri chen gyi thog 'dam/ dri chu'i theg zhal/ nyi zla'i mthong khungs/ de steng bre dang kha khyer yod pa/chos kyi 'bor lo bcu gsum brtsegs pa/ zhing lpags kyi gdugs/ shun gyi dar dpyang / tsitta'i tog /dril bu g.yer kha la theg pa chen po'i chos sgra sgrogs pa/ de'i phyi rol du dmar nag sde gsum gyi khyams
dmar po de'i mtha' mar rin po che sna lnga dang thod pa spel ba'i rtsigs pa ni skam pos 'gram gzhi byas pa rnyid pas bar rtsigs byas pa/ rlon pas kha bad/ phyi skyed kyi tshul du yod pa/ thod pa'i kha phyir bstan/ bya 'dabs ka gdung bcu drug la gdung mgo la thod pa seng marga'i tshul du yod pas kha nas me 'bar ba/ sna nas dud pa thul ba/ mig nas khrag gi zham chu 'babs pa/ sbrul gsum sgril gyi chun po 'phyang ba/ tsitta'i pho long rgyu ma'i dra ba dang dra phyed/ bar seng gi gseb nas/ 'dod yon snam bu'i steng mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas gar bsgyur ba/ zhal nang du gzigs nas mchod pa 'bul ba/ sgo bzhir sgo 'khyud can yar la 'dzeg pa'i rta bab gnyis mar la bab pa'i rta bab gnyis/ rus sbal gyi ma them/ chu srin gyi ya them/ sbrul nag gi sgo skyes/ zhing lpags kyi sgo/ rkang gi sgo rten gnam lcags kyi sgo gzer la gza' brgyad kyi gzer mgo can 'od dpag tshad bye ba yod pa/ steng na zhing gi rgyal mtshan/ dbang po'i phreng ba/ de'i steng na bre dang kha khyer chos kyi 'khor lo bcu gsum brtsegs pa/ sgo bzhi rgyal mtshan chen po bzhi btsug pa/ de yang stong gsum phur bu gsal ba'i rgya mdud la4༷༷ bhrūṃ las rab 'jigs dur khrod gzhal yas khang ltoX gru gsum mthing nag zla gam rin chen 'bar/ gru chad bar khyams sgo bzhi mu khyud rdzogs/ ngo
༄tshi/ /mtshar pho brang ye shes me 'od gsal4༷༷ phyi nang med par gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang ltoX zhes 'byung ba ltar drag po'i pho brang de yang rnam pa dur khrod chen po rab tu 'jigs pa'i wo brang de lta bu 'ang / don la rang snang ye shes kyi rang rtsal me 'od kha dog lnga ldan las grub pa'i/ shar me long ye shes kyi rang mdangs dkar po/ lho mnyam nyid ye shes kyi rang mdangs ser po/ nub sor rtog ye shes kyi rang mdangs dmar po/byang bya grub ye shes kyi rang mdangs ljang gu dbus chos dbyings ye shes kyi rang mdangs mthing kha ye shes lnga'i rang 'od las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang de yang gzhi phyogs mdog la khyad par gyi brgyan rnams so so'i mdog ltar gsal ba phyi nang med pa zang thal chen po 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba/ yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtags su gru bzhir yod pa/ phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal/ /lho ru dur khrod sku la rdzogs/ /nub tu dur khrod lang ka brtsegs/ /byang du dur khrod padma brtsegs/ /shar lho dur khrod lhun grub brtsegs / / lho nub dur khrod gsang chen rol/ /nub byang he chen brdal ba/ /byang shar 'jig rten brtsegs pa/ /de'i phyi rol du bsrung ba'i gabor lo dang bcas pa gsal bar bsgom/ de yang 'jig rten gyi
khams 'di gcig ma yin te 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya yang phur pa gcig gis khong na yod par gsungs/ de nas lha bskyed pa ni/ gzhung las/ de nyid dbus kyi gru gsum lte ba la badzra dam sogs sngags brjod pas gzhal yas khang gi dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dbus su rdo rje brag chen dang / saṃ las chags med padma dang / /a las thabs kyi rang bzhin zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ ma las shes rab rang bzhin nyi ma'i dkyil 'bor/ de'i steng snang srid pho bdud thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa rū tra pho kha sbub/ snang srid mo bdud thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo rū tra mo gan rkyal du yod pa'i steng du rgyu'i yi ge hūṃ sngon po de ye re ba gnas par bsgom/ de las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas rdo rdze gzhon nu'i go 'phang la bkod/phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas hūṃ la thim pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba gcig tu gyur/ de yang snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bsad cing mnan pa ma yin no4༷༷ phung po rdo rjer gtam byas nas4༷༷ rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgomagiX zhes pa'i don ni sngon dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nus 'jig rten gyi sems can nyon mongs pa can rnams la snying rje bskyed nas
