༄༅/ /drag po'i dgongs pas 'khor ba las sgrol bar dam bca' ba yin no/ /zhe sdang rang ga mas bsad cing gti mug 'thib pas mnan pa ni ma yin pa dang / phung po ni nyon mongs pa'i rkyen du ma 'dus zer te/rdo rje ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi don yin pas rang byung gi rig pa rang gsal la gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pas bar ma chod par bsgoms pa ni rdo rjer gtam zhes bya'o/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgoms4༷༷ zhes pa ni rgyu'i hūṃ 'od du snga 'gyur bka' ma'i phur pa phal cher gtso bo dang khro bcu sgo skyesasbyong ba'i bskyed rim mdzad pa ltar 'dir yang der mdzad zhu nas rdo rje rtse lnga par bsgom pa'i don lags/ yang rdo rje de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas rdo rje la thim pas rdo rje 'od du zhu nas zhe sdang rdo rje gzhon nu tshon gang ba thugs gar rdo rje sngon po hūṃ gis mtshan pa bsgom pa las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs dang gzi brjid rnams khro chung gi rnam par dpag tu med pa bsdus nas khro chung tshon gang ba de la thim khro chung 'od du zhu/ badzra kī lam̐ kī la sogs rtsa sngags brjod pa'i rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gsum phyag drug rdzu 'phrul gyi skang ba bzhisabadud bzhi zil gyisaganon pa'i brdar zhabs bzhi bgrad pa zhal g.yas chosasku dkar gaskurdzon sprul sku dmar dbus longs sku mthing /
phyag pha rol phyin drug yongs su rdzogs shing rgyud drug gi sdug bsngal 'joms pa'i brdar phyag drug g.yas dang po na rdo rdze rtse dgu/ gnyis pa rdo rdze rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ g.yon dang po na me dpung / gnyis pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis ri rab kyi phur bu bsgril ba/ dbu skra khams nag gyen du 'khyil ba/ thod pa skam po lnga yi dbu rgyan pa la rigs lnga'i mtshon don rin po che'i ze srog yod pa tshal bus dpung pa brgyan pa/ glang chen ko rlon sku stod la re ldeng thabs su gyon pa/ mi lpags rlon pas rked dkris byas pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsol ba ste bgo ba'i gos gsum dang / dpral bar thal chen gyi tshom bu/ sna rtse dang 'khur tshos gnyis su rakta'i thig le/ lkog dmar zo ris re byug pa'i rtsi gsum/ mi mgo skam rlon rnying gsum gyi do shal/ sbrul rigs lngas brgyan pa ni gdags pa'i rgyan gnyis te dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang / rdo rje'i gshogs pa rtag ga kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i phyir dang go khrab gnyis te dpal gyi chas bcus legs par brgyan pa/ sbrul rigs lngas brgyan pa yang rgyal rigs dkar khras thor gtsug bcing / rje rigs ser khras rin po che'i snyan cha dang lhan gcig btus pa/ bram ze'i rigs dmar khras mgul rgyan du 'phyang ba/ dmangs rigs smras khras phyag gdub byas pa/ gdol rigs nag khras zhabs gdub byas pa/ gar dgu'i nyams can de la yang sku sgegs
༄༅/ /pa / dpa' ba dang 'jigs pa ste dug gsum 'dul phyir sku'i gar gsum he he zhes gshe ba'am/ drag shul gyi nga ro dang ldan pa/ hūṃ phaṭa la sogs pa 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra/ gtum par sgrogs pa ste gsung gi gar gsum dang / thugs zhi ba snying rje chen po las ma g.yos bzhin gdul bya ma rung pa rnams 'dul phyir thabasabade ba chen po'i ye shesakyi snang cha yab kyi tshul dang / shesarab stong pa nyid la yum gyi tshul du smosanas de gnyisazung du 'jug pa phyag rgya'i rnam par bsgom pa kham du byed pa yin/ rngams pa ltar ston pa las don zhi ba chen po'i bdag nyid yin te thugs kyi gar gsum ste gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ bskal ba'i me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa sku'i ba spu thams cad khro chung mtshon gang pas gtams pa thugs gar rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' rgyan dang yum med pa zhig gsal btab/ hūṃ tib ta tsakra'i sngags brjod pa'i rkyen gyis yum chen 'bor lo rgyas 'debs ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa khro gnyer mdzum mdangs can/ phyag g.yas rdo rje thogs nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ g.yon bhan dmar dung khrag yab zhal stobs pa'i tshul can brgyan yab dang tshul mthun pa/ yab yum 'khril sbyor bde ba chen po'i ngang nas thugs ga'i sa pon las dzaXhūṃ peṃ ho las lcags kyu zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu ste/ phyag rgya bzhi 'phros pas phyogs skyongs bcu po rang dbang med par
bkugs nas/ gzhal yas kyi phyogs bcur gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i nang du padma nyi zla'i steng phyogs skyongs pho mo rnams byi chings su bsnol te sgyel ba'i steng du/ dpal chen rdo rdze gzhon nu yab yum gyi thugs ka nas hūṃ hūṃ dril ma bcu 'phros pa las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus pas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams hūṃ la thim pas 'od du zhu badzra badzra las rdo rje 'bar ba gzugs bcur gyur/ de las 'od zer spro bsdu gong ltar byas pa'i rdo rje rnams khro chung tshon gang bar gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku yi byin rlabs rnams khro chung gi rnam par bsdus te thim pa las/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams bcur khro bcu yab yum rnams gsal bar bsgoms/ de yang hūṃ ka ra'i sngags brjod pas steng phyogs tshangs pa pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du hūṃ ka ra dang khro mo sgra 'byin ma 'khril ba'i yab kyi thugs ka nas phag gi mgo can g.yas su bskyed/ yum gyi thugs ka nas dmig bu'i mgo can g.yon tu bskyed/ shar phyogs brgya byin bsnol ba'i gdan steng du oX badzra sogs rnam rgyal yab yum gyi sngags brjod pas khro kro rnam par rgyal ba khro mo rnam snyem ma yab yum rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i
༄tshi/ /yab kyi thugs ka nas rang gi mgo can g.yas su bskyed/ yum gyi thugs ka nas bya rgod mgo can g.yon du bskyed/ shar lho me lha bsnol ba'i steng du dbang phyug sngon po yab yum gyi sngags brjod pas khro bo dbyug pa sngon po khro mo rdo rje sder mo 'khril ba las yab kyi thugs ka nas g.yag gi mgo can g.yas su bskyed/ yum gyi thugs ka nas bya rog mgo can g.yon du bskyed/ lho phyogs gshin rje bsnol ba'i steng du gshin rje yab yum gyi sngags brjod pas khro bo gshin rje gshed po la khro mo dur khrod bdag mo 'khril ba'i yab kyi thugs ka nas sha ba'i mgo can g.yas su bskyed/ yum gyi thugs ka nas 'ug pa'i mgo can g.yon du bskyed/lho nub srin po bsnol ba'i steng du mi g.yo mgon po yab yum gyi sngags brjod pas khro bo mi g.yo mgon po khro mo gtun khung ma 'khril ba'i yab kyi thugs ka nas gzig gi mgo can g.yas su bskyed/ yum gyi thugs ka nas kha ta'i mgo can g.yon tu bskyed/ nub phyogs klu dbang bsnol ba'i steng du rta mgrin yab yum gyi sngags brjod pas khro bo rta mgrin rgyal po khro mo dbang bsdud ma 'khril yab kyi thugs ka nas byi la'i mgo can g.yas su bskyed/ yum gyi thugs ka nas pu shud mgo can g.yon du bskyed/ nub byang rlung lha bsnol ba'i steng du g.yin gyi mi thub yab yum gyi sngags brjod pas khro bo gzhan gyi mi thub pa khro mo mda' snyom ma 'khril
ba'i yab kyi thugs ka nas spyang ga'i mgo can g.yas su bskyed/ yum gyi thugs ka nas khra yi mgo can g.yon du bskyed/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin bsnol ba'i steng du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yab yum gyi sngags brjod pas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la khro mo rlung 'byin ma 'khril pa las yab kyi thugs ka nas seng ge'i mgo can g.yas su bskyed/ yum gyi thugs ka na pha waṃ mgo can g.yon du bskyed/ byang shar dbang ldan bsnol pa'i steng du khams gsum rnam rgyal yab yum gyi sngags brjod pas khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal la khro mo gsod byed ma 'khril ba/ yab kyi thugs ka nas dred kyi mgo can g.yas su bskyed/ yum gyi thugs ka nas sre mong mgo can g.yon du bskyed/ 'og phyogs sa bdag bsnol ba'i steng du stobs po che yab yum gyi sngags brjod pas khro bo stobs po che khro mo bskyed byed ma 'khril ba yab kyi thugs ka nas dom gyi mgo can g.yas su bskyed/yum gyi thugs ka nas byi ba'i mgo can g.yon du bskyed/ de ltar khro po dang khro mo sprul pa dang bcas pa rnams sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag gnyis dbang drag gi phur pa bsgril zhing dgra bgegs sgrol ba/ sku stod khro bo la sku smad gnam lcags las grub pa'i phur pa mgar gyi so mal nas drangs ma thag lta bu phyogs skyong dregs pa thal gyi byung ba/ rdo rje'i gshog pa dang dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ /yum
༄༅/ /rnams kyang mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ galngardzon pas thod khrag yab la zhal bstan pa khro 〈sna'i chas kun lngardzongs su dzamags pa/ phra thabs kun kyang lcags kyu dang phur pa sgril ba/ gtso 'khor thams cad bskal ba'i me dpungs 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ thugs gar nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ sngon po'i mtha' bskor du rang rang sngags kyi bskor ba/ zhal nas hūṃ phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pas srid pa gsum dang 'khor ba zil gyis gnon par gsal ba ni phyogs bcu'i khro bo'i dkyil 'khor yin lags/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum du gsal ba'i ngang nas dril sgrub ltar lus dkyil nas gsal 'debs pa ni gzhung du gsal ba ltar khro bcu so so'i sngags brjod pas rang gi gnas su bsgom dgos pa yang / bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i dbu gtsug khro rgyal hūṃ ka ra dang khro mo sgra 'byin gnyis kyi thugs ka nas phra thabs phag dang dmig bu'i mgo can gnyis phyogs bcu'i khro bo ltar g.yas g.yon du bskyed/ de bzhin du thugs gar khro bo rnam par rgyal ba dang yum chen rnam snyem ma phra thabs stag dang bya rgod mgo can/ nu ma g.yas pa'i steng dbyug pa sngon po dang khro mo rdo rje sder mo sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo can/ dpung ba g.yas su khro bo gshin rje gshed po dang khro mo dur khrod bdag mo sprul ba sha ba
'ug pa'i mgo can/ sog pa g.yas pa'i steng khro bo mi g.yo mgon po dang khro mo rdo rje gtun khung ma sprul pa gzig dang kha ta'i mgo can/ rgyab kyi sog dbrag tu khro bo rta mgrin rgyal po dang yum chen gtum mo dbang bsdud ma sprul ba byi la pu shud mgo can sog pa g.yon pa'i steng khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang yum chen rdo rje mda' bsnyen ma sprul pa spyang ku khra yi mgo can/ dpung ba g.yon pa'i steng khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang yum bdud rtsi rlung 'byin ma sprul pa seng ge pha waṃ mgo can/ nu ma g.yon pa'i steng khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal dang yum chen gsod byed ma sprul pa dred dang sre mong mgo can/ 'og phyogs gsang gnas bcu drug mdor khro bo stobs po che/ yum rdo rje bskyed byed ma sprul pa dom dang byi ba'i mgo can bskyed/ sku lus kyi ba spu'i sgo thams cad khro chung 'jigs su rung ba mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir zhal phyir gzigs pa khrab ltar gtam par bsgom/ oX badzra gha ru ṭa hūṃ phaṭa4༷༷ lte ba'i gnas su khyung dkar po gnam lcags kyi gshogs pa dang mchu sder can gser mig 'khyil ba rdo rje'i mchu can/ gnam lcags kyi sder mos sbrul bzung nas za ba zhig bsgom/ de ltar bdag nyid rtsa ba'i lus dkyil dang bcas pa rnams kyang khro bo'i gar dgu sogs gtum rngams rab tu khros pas cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sku stod khro bo la sku smad phur pa'i
༄tshi/ /dbal can bskal ba'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa ni bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gong du phyogs bcur khro bcu phra phyag rnams bsgom pa ni phyogs bcu'i khro po'i dkyil 'khor mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor ni bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / shar gyi khro bo rnam rgyal gyi bar de rdul mtshon nam ras bris phur cha/ gtor ma sogs rgyas bsdus gang rig bshams pa ni mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor de yang bdag mdun gnyis me 'ordzong nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ gzhal yas lha tshogs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig 'don cha tshar gcig gi gsal 'debs pa ni mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'bor sgo gsum gyi srasmchog bskyed par gsungs te mngal skyes sbyong ba la bka' ma'i dgongs pa sras mchog bskyed pa ni bdag mdun gnyis kyi bar der mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gdan la thugs kyi sras mchog badzra kī la ya sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rgya gram phur pa sgril ba/ sku smad zur gsum phur pa'i dbal can rdo rje'i gathekhog pa dang dur khrod chas kyi brgyan pa/ zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las thogs med du 'grub pa'i bdag nyid can du gsal / gzhan yang bsgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi bsgom don du sras mchog rigs bzhi dang phur pa che mchog tu sku gsung thugs kyi sras gsum bsgom tshul dang / chos dbang rin po che'i phur pa spu gri las sras mchog
nyer gcig bsgom tshul drarshags bshad kyang 'dir byang gter spu gri gzhung ltar/ tiṣṭha lhan zhesapa rog phur dang rong phur dag bsnyen phur srasamachog tu bskyesan 'di skabasabyug bdug brab gsum mdzad nas phur gdan la bzhugs su gsol ba dang cha 'dra snyam/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang mdun bskyed gtso bo'i mdun du las phur phrin las bzhi thog /thogs /med du 'grub pa'i bdag nyid thugs kyi sras mchog badzra ki la yar gsal 'debs dgos lags/ sras mchog 'di rang la mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor tshang tshul bshad / bdag mdun gnyis gzhal yas kyi thod pa skam rlon rnying gsum gyis brtsegs pa'i nang rol dmar nag sde gsum gyis 'khyams la/ dam can ma mo bcu gnyis gsal 'debs dgos pas/ phur pa che mchog gi phrin las su gtso bo'i g.yas su bse yi lha mo bzhi/ g.yon du shwa na mu kha mched bzhi dang / mdun du dpal ldan lha mo bzhi rnams bskyed/ ces 'byung ba dang rdo rdze phur pa thugs gsang ba sku yi rgyud las g.yas dkar gshin rje gshed po dngos/ bse mo'i glad /klad /khrag 'dren par byed/ g.yon dmar rta mgrin rgyal po dngos4༷༷ shwa na'i mgrin srog gcod pa byedagiXdbus mthing bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i zhal4༷༷ nag mo'i tsitta 'dren par byedagiX zhes gsungs pas bskul byang ltar/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho khyams gtso bo'i g.yas zhal dkar po'i mdun ngos su/ nam gyi tho rangs dam
༄༅/ /bcas pa'i bse mo bzhi rim gyis bskyed pa ni/ rdo rje ya byin bal yul mthing nag lcags phur gyi ral pa can lcags phur sgril ba/ bdud rta nag po la zhon pa/ rdo rje de phyin phag ser mo kong yul la gser phur gyi ral pa can gser gyi phur pa bsgril ba/ gza' rta ser po la zhon pa/ /rdo rje bse phyin khrag dmar po bse phur gyi ral ba can bse yi phur pa bsgril pa/ btsan rta dmar zhur la zhon pa/ rdo rje phag 'o ma phyin ljang mo g.yu phur gyi ral pa can g.yu yi phur pa bsgril ba/ klu rta sngon po la zhon pa'o/ /'di bzhi po sa bdag ma chen mo bzhi bgrang zhing phur pa mchog gi rgyud las/ mar khu khrag zhag 'o ma bzhi/ /dkyil 'khor bar khyams dag tu bzhag /zhes gsungs pa ltar sa bdag ma bzhi mar khu khrag zhag 'o ma'i mtsho bzhi gnas par bshad/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang 'khyams gtso bo'i g.yon zhal dmar po'i mdun ngos su nam gyi srod la dam bcas pa'i shwa na ma bzhi ni/ shwa na mu kha lcags mgo can sngon mo lcags phur sgril pa lcags spyang mgo dgu la zhon pa/ shwa na mu kha nag 57 g.yu yi maskyurdzo can g.yu'i phur pa bsgril/ g.yu'i khyi mo ral pa can la zhon pa/ sho la mu kha'am sri la mu ser mo gser gyi mgo can gser phur sgril ba/ gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad la zhon pa/ sring ga la mu kha dmar mo zangs mgo can zangs phur bsgril ba/ zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum la zhon pa/
dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs gtso bo'i dbus zhal mthing ga'i mdun ngos nam gyi gung la dam bcas pa'i re ti mched bzhi'am 'di bzhisadusabazhi'i rgyal mo yang mdzad bdag nyid ma bzhi po ni/ re ma ti nag mo ral pa can phyag na mchog phur zhes mi rkang gi phur pa bsgril ba/ drel rta rkang gsum la zhon pa/ /re ma ti ser nag rma bya'i thul pa can mchog phur sgril ba/ chu glang sngon po la zhon pa/ re ma dza ston dmar nag re lde nag po gsol zhing mchog phur bsgril ba sha ba yu mo la zhon pa/ re ma dzu dgun ljang nag dar nag gi go zu gsol ba mchog phur sgril ba/ rnga mong gwa pa la zhon pa'o/ /de ltar bar 'khyams kyi phyogs gsum po der dam can ma mo bcu gnyis rnams bskyed/ gtso po'i thugs ka nas dzaXhūṃ baṃ ho rnams sgo bzhir 'phros pa las pho brang gi sgo bzhir shar sgor dzaX lho sgor 〉giX nub sgor baṃ/ byang sgor ho/ rnams 'od du zhu ba las nyi las bzhi bsgrub pa'i phyir ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng zhing skyang gi gdan drod skyesasbyong ba la shar sgor dkar mo pu shud mgo can lcags kyu thogs pa/ lho sgor ser mo skya ga'i mgo can zhags pa thogs pa/ nub sgo dmar po srin bya'i mgo can lcags sgrog thogs pa/ byang sgo ljang mo khra yi mgo can dril bu thogs pa rnams bskyed/ rin chen phun tshogs gzhan bdud 'dul shā pho brang phyi rol dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus/ bse lcags dung gsum la sogs wo nya bzhugs/ zhes
༄tshi/ /gsungs pas pho brang gi phyi rol dur khrod brgyad kyi gnas su bse lcags dung gsum bskyed dgos pa yang / pho brang gi phyi rol dur khrod brgyad kyi lho'i 'khyams la sa bdag ma bzhi'am bse mo bzhi'i ming po dung gi skyes bu bzhi bskyed pa ni/ snang ba ldog byed gsal snang dang ldan pa ldog byed lha'i nga rgyal la bslab dgosashing de yang snga ma las kyang phyi ma gtso che/ pra ma ra tsa srin po'i ging / dkar po dung phur sgril ba ya ma ra tsa gshin rje'i ging sngon po ral gri dang phur pa sgril ba/ dā sha ghri wa bdud kyi ging dmar po ral gri dang phur pa sgril ba'o/ yakṣa gri wa gnod sbyin gyi ging ser po phur pa sgril ba'o/ /dur khrod kyi byang 'khyams la shwa na ma bzhi'i ming po bse yi skyes bu bzhi bskyed pa ni/ srin po'i skyes bu srin po khyad chen dkar po dung phur bsgril ba/ gshin rje'i skyes bu ya ma nag po lcags phur sgril ba/ ya bdud skyes bu sogs po mi ring dmar po zangs phur sgril ba gnod sbyin skyes bu mon pa mig ring sngon po g.yu phur sgril ba'o/ dur khrod shar 'khyams su bdag nyid ma bzhi'am re ma ti bzhi'i ming po lcags kyi skyes bu bzhi bskyed pa ni/ shar bdud dkar po mche ba gtsigs pa dung gi phur pa sgril ba/ /lho bdud sngon po ral pa can g.yu yi phur pa sgril ba/ nub bdud nag po zhags pa dang phur pa sgril ba/ byang bdud ljang gu ral gri dang phur pa sgril ba/ de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi nang 'khyams lho byang
shar gsum du ma mo bcu gnyis dang / de bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi tpū 'khyams lho byang shar gsum po der bse lcags dung gsum gyi skyes bu bcu gnyis bskyed pa las dur khrod kyi nub phyogs lha gnas med pa ni gtso bo la rgyab zhal med pa'i phyir ro zhes rgyud las gsungs de ltar phur srung dam can sgo ma rnams phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor dang mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'bor gnyis ka la bsgom nas/ srog ye shes su bskyed nas srog la dbang bskur ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas dbang lha rig lnga yab yum sems dpa' lcam dral khro bo khro mo rig 'dzin dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ hūṃ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ zhes gsol ba btabs pas nam mkha'i dbang lha rnams kyis/ hūṃ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don dugiX zhes sogs sngags brjod pa dang lhan gcig tu mi bskyod pas bum pa/ rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan/ snang mthas rdo rje/ don grub kyi dril bu/ rnam snang gis ming dbang rnams dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs la bskur ba'i tshe gtso bo yab yum gyi rdo rje'i glu dang /sems dpa' rnams kyis shis brjod kyi me tog 'thor/ sems ma rnams kyis me tog 'bul/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad pa sogs mdzad pas bum dbang dang / dbang lha yab yum rnams sbyor ba mdzad pa'i
༄༅/ /byang sems dkyil 'bor gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi smyi bor thim pas gsang dbang / dbang lha yab yum rnams rjes chags kyis mer gyi zhu ste dkyil 'khor gsum la thim pas dbang gsum pa/ de'i ye shes bde stong gi don la bzhag pas dbang bzhi pa thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las dbang rtags su rigs lngas rgyan par mos pa ni lugs 'di'i khyad par gyi dbang bskur ba yin/ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūṃ srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa dang ltoX zhes sogs shwa lo ka dang pos rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i rnam par rong gi bzhengs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyis phyag 'tshal bas/ ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos pra titstsha ho:༷༷ zhes len du dngos grub byin zhing 'bor rnams kyis phyag lan 'tshal bar mos/ hūṃ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs4༷༷ brjod pa'i tshe dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ga'i hūṃ 'od kyis bskul bas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rten dang brten par bcas/ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs rten dang brten par babs pa thams cad dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor du thim pas dam tshig ye shes dbyer med du chu la chu bzhag pa ltar du ma ro gcig tu gyur pas slar yang bkrag mdangs gzi brjid
dang ldan par mos/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni gong du byin gyis rlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ hūṃ 'dod yon mang pos bde gshegs mchodagiX zhes sogs tshig rjes don dran nas 'dod yon gyi lha mo rnams so so'i gnas su thim pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la dgyes pa bskyed par mos/ de nas gzhung gi dkyus ltar/ hūṃ rang byung gdod nas dag pa sogs dang brgyud pa'i mtshan don rnams brjod pa'i tshe/ gong du byin gyis rlabs pa'i bdud rtsi g.yas su dkrug cing dkyil 'khor la gtor bas bdud rtsi zegs ma phyogs bcur 'phros/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus bdud rtsi bcud drangs te gsol bas sku gsung thugs mnyes shing tshim pas bdag gzhan gyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa skad cig la dag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi spyi bo nas oX dkar po/ mgrin par āXdamar po/ thugs ka nas hūṃ masang ka rnams 'phros te bdud rtsi'i nang du bab/ hūṃ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing ltoX zhes sngags dang bcas brjod cing bdud rtsi nas mtheb srin gyis blangs te rang gi spyi bor mgrin pa snying ka rnams su reg pas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams rang gi gnas gsum du thim par mos pa ni bdud rtsi'i dngos grub len pa'o/ hūṃ dam rdzas rmad byung gter chen po4༷༷ zhes sngags brjod pas gong du byin gyis rlabs pa'i gtor ma
༄tsho/ /de'i stod kyai cha la mdun bskyed lha tshogs rnams gsal zhing / smad kyi cha la 'dod yon gyi lha mo dpag tu med pa 'phros4༷༷ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams mchod pas lha tshogs rnams kyis ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can gyi bcud drangs te gsol bar bsam/ rakta'i mchod pa ni/ hūṃ nyon mongs rtsa ba sogs sngags bcas brjod la gtor ma grub blang / dam rdzas rmad byung sogs kyi gtor ma dang /nyon mongs rtsa ba sogs kyi rakta dbul/ de nas thod par sman rag gnyis bsres ste blug pa dkyil 'bor gyi mdun du bkod nas/ de la dmigs te sgrol ba'i mchod pa la/ dam tshig chen po sogs babs brgyad kyi pho nya btang / byang chub mchog tu zhes sogs sngags tshig dang bcas pas dgra bgegs 'gugs 'ching sdom myos dang / dngos grub bar gcod sogs kyi mjug tu sngags kyi tshe/ phur pa bsgril zhing bsgral ba'i dmigs pa bya/ rnam shes dpal chen yab yum gyi mkha' gsang du 'phangs te bzhag phung po bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus gsum bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gsum la mchod skabs/ gong gi bsgral bya'i rnam shes dpal chen yab yum gyi mkha' gsang du 'phangs pa de nyid la gtor bas zhing bcu ru tra rgyud drug bsgral ba'i rakta'i rgya mtsho zer ma la 'dod yon gyi lha mo dpag tu med pa 'phros nas dkyil 'khor gsum la mchod
pas rang bzhin gyi 'dod chags rtsad nas bcad/ skye ba med pa'i don rgyud la skye bar mos/ de nas thod par bdud rtsi dang rakta gnyis bsres nas dkyil 'bor gyi mdun du bkod nas de la dmigs te bsgral ba'i mchod pa la/ dam tshig chen po sogs babs brgyad kyi pho nya las mkhan rnams bskul/ byang chub mchog rkang pa gsum gyisagasol ba gdab pa dang yang rkang pa gsum gyisabasgral bya dang rkang pa lngas sgrol lo cesapa sogs kyi sngags tshig brjod pas dgra bgegs 'gugs 'chings sdom myos dang / dngos grub bar gcod sogs kyi mjug tu sngags kyi tshe phur pa sgril zhing bsgral ba'i dmigs pa bya/ rnam shes dpal chen yab yum gyi mkha' gsang du 'phangs dgra bgegs 'byung po bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus gsum bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gsum la mchod pas lhag ma ma lus par gsol bar bsam ste/ sman raka bsres pa gtor ma rnams la sbran/ sbyor ba'i mchod pa ni/ khro mo 'bar ba'i mkha' dbyings sugiX zhes sogs sngags tshig skabs gong gi bsgral bya'i rnam shes dpal chen yab yum gyi mkha' gsang du 'phangs pa de nyid dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pas yab kyi rdo rjes yum gyi gsang ba'i gtun du brdungs pas dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs bde ba chen pos dgyes/ dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes sbyor mtshams su rgyal ba'i sras su bskyed par bsam mo/
༄tshi/ /de rjes hūṃ dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus 'dus pa'i dpal4༷༷ zhes sogs bstod pa bya'o/ /de nas 'dzab la 'jug pa ni las byang gi dkyus ltar/ rang nyid dpal chen skur gsal ba'igiX thugs gar ye shes sems dpa' nigiX zhes sogs brjod la bzlas pa bya ba ni/ gsung bzlasapa'i rnal 'byor gyi sbyang bya ma dag 'bor ba'i ming tshig yi ge ngag gi brjod pa'i bag chags dang / sbyong byed sngags kyi sgra rnams yang yang zlosapa/ sbyang 'brasagasung rdo rje'i phrin las kyisa'agro don mdzad pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa'o/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams gsal ba'i ngang nas bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum lus dkyil dang bcas pa gsal ba'i mdun/ phyogs bcu khro po'i dkyil 'bor gyi shar phyogs rnam par rgyal ba za gsod dang bcas pa'i bar der gnas pa'i mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'drar gsal gtso bo rdo rje gzhon nu dang rang nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'drar rdo rje gzhon nu gnyis ga'i thugs gar ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra ba rgyan dang phyag mtshan mi mnga' ba mtshon gang ba/ de'i thugs gar nyi ma'i gdan la rdo rje rtse dgu nas 'bru gyen du slong ba tsam gyi lte bar nyi gdan la thugs srog yi ge hūṃ sngon po'i mthar oX badzra kī laṃ kī la ya sarba big nan rba hūṃ phaṭaX dza hūṃ āX zhes pa'i yig 'bru gser mdog can spu rtses bris pa tsam gyis g.yas bskor du 'khor zhing zhal nang du lta ba/ bdag mdun gyi gtso bo'i thugs
srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa'i 'od zer nyi ma'i snying po ltar 'bar zhing 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams la 'od zer gyi rtse la mchod pa'i sprin spros te mchod/ sems can gyi don byas 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus bdag la thim pas sgo gsum gyi las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa nyi ma shar ba'i mun pa ltar dngas bar bsam pa dang / yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par rong rong gyur pa dang / de bzhin du gsung yig 'bru thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par byon nas dkyil 'bor gsum la thim pa dang / yang 'od zer 'phros pas phyi nang snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang / nang bcud sems can rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha/ sgra grags thams cad sngags sgrar shes pa de dag kyang thun mthar bdag gis bsgom pa'i rten brten pa la thim pas gzi brjid rgyas par bsam pa ni bdag byin rlabs pa'o/ /bdag mdun do li'i bzlas pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i thugs ga'i sngags phreng las rdo rje'i rwa dbus ma la gyen du thon te ye shes sems dpa'i shangs g.yas nas thon/ rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i shangs g.yas nas phyir byon te mdun gyi gtso bo'i shangs g.yon nas zhugs thugs ga'i ye shes sems dpa'i shangs g.yon brgyud rdo rje'i rwa dbus mar
༄tshi/ /brgyud / thugs srog sngags phreng la bskor te thugs dam gyi brgyud bskul/ slar yang rdo rje'i rwa dbus ma nas gyen du thon te ye shes sems dpa' dang gtso bo gnyis kyi shangs g.yas nas thon/ rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i shangs g.yon dang thugs ga'i ye shes sems dpa'i shangs g.yon brgyud rdo rje'i rwa dbus su zhugs te thugs srog sngags phreng la bskor ba 'di mgal me ltar drag tu bskor zhing bzlas/ thun mthar dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams las 'od zer dkar po 'phros te bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad zhi ba dang / 'od zer ser po 'phros pas snang srid 'khor 'das kyi tshe dpal yon tan thams cad bsdus nas rang la thim pas rgyas pa dang / 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bur 'phros te snang srid 'khor 'das dbang du bsdu ba dang 'od zer ljang nag me'i tsha tsha dang mtshon cha'i dbal lta bu 'phros te dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa drag po ste las bzhi'i bzla tshul sogs dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du rnams ma yengs par bya dgos/ de yang gtso bor gnas lugs lta ba'i ngang nas bzla dgos zhing / dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du de dag kyang ting 'dzin grogs su 'gyur phyir thabs la mkhas pas gsungs pa yin cing de ltar bzlas pa'i rim pa brgya stong khri 'bum sogs long skabs dang sbyar te bzlas mthar/ hūṃ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang dugiX kun
bzang che mchog he ru gagiX zhes sogs 'dzab bskul/ phur pa yongs rdzogs spyan 'dren gshegs/ /sogs stong tshig gis dkyil 'khor gsum la mchod pa dang / bskal ba me ltar 'bar ba sogs kyis bstod pa bya / hūṃ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing ltoX zhes sogs rig 'dzin rnams bskul bas so so'i zhing khams nas mdun gyi nam mkhar byon te rjes 'jug rig 'dzin bsgrub pa po'i bar gcod sel zhing sku gsung thugs kyis bsgrub pa po'i lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlabs par mos/ de ltar gter srung rnams dang brten pa'i srung ma spyir bskang gso rgyas par btang / khyad par phur srung mchod pa dkar bdud gnyis dang dam can ming sring gi gtor ma re yaṃ khaṃ gis bsreg gtor bkrus/ oX āXhūṃ ho lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i bskang rdzas rnams 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes pa dam can rnams dgyes pa bskyed nus pa zhig tu byin gyis rlabs la/ hūṃ bhyo mdun du pad zla'i gdan steng dugiX bhyo las dkar mo nyi zla nigiX zhes sogs dkyus ltar mdzad rjes/ /tshogs bya ba ni tshogs kyi skabs 'dir gsang sngags nang ba'i /pa'i /mchod pa'i gtso bor gyur pa bla med yang dag gi mchod pa zhes sdig sgrib nyes ltung las nyon bag chags dam tshig nyams chag rnams bskang ba'i thabs khyad par can yin par gsungs zhing / tshogs rdzas kyang sha mar dang / bdud
༄7/ /rtsi lnga gtso bor gyur pa yin kyang bdud rtsi sman mchod sogs kyi phab rgyun las dngos su bshams pa ni snyigs dus 'gro ba'i blor mi shong / sha yang rab tu byung na tshong dus chen po gsum 'grim pa dang / chang yang 'bru bcud stong sbyar gyi dpa' bo kho na dgos pa dang / dam tshig nyams pa'i lag nas byung ba'i dngos po spangs bya dang / rnal 'byor pho rkyang gi tshogs pa la dpa' bo'i dga' ston/ mo rkyang gi tshogs pa la dpa' mo'i dga' ston zer ba dang / pho mo thabs shes 'dzoms pa la tshogs kyi 'khor lo zer ba dang / thabs shes ma 'dzoms na tshogs 'khor tshad ldan min pa sogs rgyas bshad rnams rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi 'bor lo'i rnam bshad rnams su gsal la/ 'gag don snying por dril ba rnal 'byor pa bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin la dbang 'byor pas byin gyis rlabs na tshogs rdzas kyang sha chang gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' ba dang / bca' ba btung ba logs kyi dngos po'i rigs rnams tshogs rdzas su mi 'gro ba med cing / snod bcud rnams dag pa rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor du skad cig gis byin gyis rlobs nus pa/ tshogs mgron kyang / bla ma yi dam gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad skad cig yud tsam gyis spyan 'dren nus pa dang / de yang thugs sgrub kyi tshogs 'bul skabs/ snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten
gtor gzhong dugiX srid pa bcud kyi sems can gtor ma bshams4༷༷ zhes gsungs pas/ rnal 'byor pa byin rlabs nus ma nus kyi khyad par ni che lags/ ka pā la'i zhing lpags sam gcan gzan gyi lpags pa'i steng sha chang gtso por gyur pa'i bza' bca' btung ba'i dngos po gang 'byor bshams/ bsang chu dang bdud rtsi 'thor zhing rang nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i thugs kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i raṃ 'phros pas tshogs rdzas kyi steng du bab pa las me byung ste ma dag pa'i dngos 'dzin bsregs/ yaṃ 'phros pas rlung byung bas dngos 'dzin ma dag pa rnam gtor/ khaṃ 'phros pas chu byung bas tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin ma dag pa bkrus/slar yang yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raṃXlas me yi dkyil 'khor thod pa'i sgyed po'i steng du āXlas ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shong rgya che ba'i nang du tshogs kyi yo byad rnams sbyangs rtog sbar ba la brten pa'i sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi chen po 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i rang bzhin sprin phung 'phro ba zad mi shes pa'i rang bzhin du byin gyis rlabs te/ oX āXhūṃ lan gsum brjod/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni sgrub gtor la shes pa gsum ldan dang / bzhi ldan/ drug ldan/ dgu ldan/ la sogs gsungs pas/ gong du las gzhung gtor 'bul skabs su mchod rdzas su shes dkrerdzos pa las/ de yang
༄tshi/ /dkyil 'khor rdul tshon dang / ras bris phur cha sogs med pa'i tshom bu la brten nas sgrub gtor lta bu'i tshe/ sgrub gtor gyi sked pa yan chad mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gsal zhing /sgrub gtor gyi sked pa man 'dod yon gyi lha mos gang ba gsal ba dang / 'dir yang gtor ma ltar shes pa'i skabs bcas sgrub gtor ltar gsal 'debs dgos/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni dkyil 'khor gsum dang gtor ma lhar gsal ba rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa rnams tshogs mgron gyis tshul du spyan drangs nas so sor stim la/ hūṃ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang ltoX zhes sngags dang bcas pa bya'o/ /de ltar spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa'i lha mo du mas tshogs mchod 'dod yon gyi phung pos mchod par dmigs la badzra ambha sogs dang / bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa sbyar ba 'diljoX zhes sogs sngags dang bcas te brjod pa ni phyir mchod pa'o/ /bye brag tu thog mtha' bar gsum las dang po mchod pa ni/ las byed pas tshogs spros te gtor ma sbran la sman raka gtor/ hūṃ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kun4༷༷zhes sogs kyis phul/ de yang gtor bzlog sogs dang 'brel tshe bzlog pa'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon ras bris kyi steng bzlog gtor gtso 'khor bcu gcig pa thebs kyu grangs med kyis bskor ba theb kyu'i bcad kha
phyir bstan pa dug khrag gis ngar blud pa/ tshe yungs gtsang mar dha dhi/ gtor gdugs bzlog 'bor/ dam can ming sring gi bzlog gtor gtso 'khor bcu gnyis pa tshe yungs kyis brgyan pa sogs phyag len ltar sgrub dkyil gyi g.yon du bkod pa las dkyil 'bor bskyed chog spyan 'dren mchod bstod bzlas pa sogs mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor ltar me ri 'dabs 'brel gyi tshul du gsal btab la/ tshogs phud zur pa zhig bzlog dkyil du 'bul/ de nas bar pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ tshogs phud bar pa phul la/ bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi/ zhes sogs mjug tu bzhi spel gyi yig brgya sham bu can bzlas/ tha ma bsgral ba ni/ zan ling ngam/ tshogs zan sha dum dang bcas pa slob dpon gyi mdun du bkod la/ yi dam rtsa sngags mthar 'gugs 'ching sdom myos dbye bskrad kyi sngags dang phyag rgya bya/ dmigs pa brtan pos yi dam rtsa sngags mthar snra tri hur thro sogs kyis phur pa bsgril zhing tshe khrus dgongs pa gsum ldan gyi bsgral te ling ro la bdud rtsi bran nas/ hūṃ dpal chen 'khor bcas zhal phyes sogs brjod nas bsgral bya'i dug gsum gyi ngo bo sha khrag rus gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis lhag ma ma lus pa gsol bar bsam/ skabs 'dir rtsa gsum bskang gso dang / phur pa'i bskang ba rnams mdzad dgos pa yin/ rgyun gyi cho
༄tshi/ /ga'i skabs 'di tsam gyis chog la/ gtor bzlog tshogs dang sbrel ba'i rgyas par spro na tshogs bar ba phul tshar ba dang rtsa gsum bskang gso/ phur pa'i bskang ba rnams mdzad pa grub rjes phur pa 'grub nas gdab las bya zhes gsungs pas/ gzhan yang dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nus 'khor ba'i sems can dug lnga shas che ba rnams zhi bas 'dul dka' bar bstan pa/ drag po mngon spyod kyi dgongs pas 'khor ba las sgrol bar dam bcas pa yin pas gdabs las gtso che bar gsungs pa dang / slob dpon gyi mdun du zan ling skye mched tshang pa mya ngan gyi 'dug stangs can khrag byung pa dang / mgyogs phur/ gdab phur/ mchog phur te sras mchog phur pa yungs dkar nag lcags phye zangs phye/ thal chen skye tshe rnams dug ngar blud pa dang / dug khrag gri gug gam/ sgrol gri/ tho ba/ hoX gzar/ yang na gru sogs tho ba dang dpyi mig gtun khung rnams 'du byas la/ khrag skyems bshams la rig 'dzin bskul ba ni/ hūṃ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing ltoX zhes sogs kyi rig 'dzin rnams bskul ba dang / hūṃ bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi/zhes sogs kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs khro bcu phra phyag sgo ma bka' srung dam can ming sring rnams bskul ba'i skabs bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje gzhon nu thugs srog sngags phreng las 'od 'phros/ mdun
bskyed mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs gar phog pas rgyud bskul slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros bzlog dkyil lha tshogs rnams la phog pas de rnams kyis sngon nas zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam bca' rnams rjes su dran nas so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ gzhan yang bdag mdun thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros ste la las 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i phrin las bsgrub/ la las 'byor drug spel ba'i phrin las bsgrub/ la las mos pa rnam bzhi'i tshul gyi thams cad dbang du bsdu/ la las drag po tshar gcod kyi las bsgrub ste dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po zhing bcu ru tra rnams stong gsum 'jig rten du sdod pa'i dbang med pa'i 'gugs 'chings sdom myos kyi/ las thogs med du sgrub par mos/ sngags pa drag po'i chas su zhugs nas gser skyems / mkhyen gsol gzu dpang / brub khung bskyed chog 'gugs gzhug lha dbye sogs bka' brgyad ltar yid ches par byas la/ slar yang drag po'i phrin las nan tan du bskul ba ni lag gnyis rdor dril thogs la / hūṃ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang ltoX zhes sogs gzhung ltar babs brgyad kyi bskul gyi rim gyis sngags brjod pas/ skabs so so'i mtshams su mgyogs phur gdab phur/ skam thun/ dam can phur pa/ sgrol
༄༅/ /gri / dug khrag tho ba/ hom gzar du brgyud pa sogs thun rdzas drug gi bsnun pas rgyud drug tu skye ba'i sgo bcad par bsam/ de nas sras mchog phur pa sgril zhing / hūṃ sku stod khro bo chen po la4༷༷ zhes sogs gdangs dang bcas pas drag tu sgril zhing tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa ni/ dgra'i khrus lung dang rnal 'byor tshe lung ngo / de yang slob dpon chen pos khrus kyi dgongs pa ma shes na ngan sngags dang khyad med/ gnas spar pa'i cho ga ma shes na shan pa dang khyad med ces gsungs pas tshe khrus gnas spar dang bcas nges par gal che zhing / dang po khrus lung la ldog brdug 'byams gsum skyon bsal phyir/ gsal ba gsum ldan gyi ngang nas dgongs pa gsum gsal 'debs dgos pas de nas bdag rdo rje gzhon nur ma gsal na 3rdzog phur pa sras mchog tu ma gsal na brdug gzas pa po dgra bgegs dngos su ma gsal na 'byams 'grerdzo bas de gsum gal che bar gsungs/ de'i ngang nas khrus lung gsum dang dgongs pa gsum gyi gnad shes dgos pas/ āXdakar bya dkar gyi dgongs pa/ thugs rjes 'brel thag gi dgongs pa/ gdung ba lu gu brgyud kyi dgongs pa dang gsum yin pas de yang slob dpon rang nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'bor de'i 'khor du phyogs bcu'i khro bo'i dkyil 'bor/ mdun bskyed mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor gsum gsal ba'i ngang nas lag pa
g.yas g.yon rigs lnga yab yum du gsal bas sras mchog phur ba sgril bas dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum du āXdakar po re re gsal ba'i 'od zer sne la a dkar po bya pho gdangs la sgrigs pa lta bur dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad āXdakar po'i rnam par spyan drangs nas dkyil 'khor gsum la thim pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ bde stong gi ngang la gsal gdab pa nang gi khrus lung ngam rnal 'byor pa'i khrus lung / yang dkyil 'khor gsum gyi āXlas 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs pa ni khams gsum sems can gyi khrus lung /'od zer āXdakar po'i rnam par tshur 'dus pa de dgra bgegs kyi gnas gsum du thim pas kho'i sdig sgrib dag nas bsgral ba'i bskal ba dang ldan par bsam pa ni dgra'i khrus lung / 'od zer āXdakar po'i rnam par tshur 'dus de ltar khrus lung la dgongs pa gsum du tshangs ste āXdakar bya dkar gyi dgongs pa ni dpe yin/ thugs rje 'brel thag gi dgongs pa ni bdag phur liṅga gsum dgongs pa gcig tu 'brel/ dam tshig gcig gis 'brel/ chos nyid gcig gis 'brel bas na thugs rje 'brel thag gi dgongs pa dang / sems can thams cad snying rjes mi gtong zhing khyad par bsgral bya snying rje'i sgo nas 'khor bar mi gtong ba ni gdung
༄༅/ /ba lu gu rgyud kyi dgongs pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa rnal 'byor pa'i tshe lung ni/ slar yang phur ba bsgril bas/ kho'i srog gi ngo bo tshe bal rgya 'dra ba/ khrag sbal bye'u ka na ta'i mgo bo tsam pa'i dngas ma rgyus pa brdad pa ltar 'dra ba dbugs kyi dwangs ma gser sa 'og tu sbas pa'i rlangs pa tsam gyi nang du yi ge āXdakar po'i dbus su thig le 'od kyi rang bzhin can gyi dkyil du yi ge dṛ dud kha yod par bsam nas de la dmigs nas snying gar btab pas phur ba'i 'od zer me yi tshwa tsha lta bur rtse mo rno dbal gyi tshe srog bal skya lta bu de dbral nas khrag gi dwangs ma mar la lcags sreg phog pa ltar skam rtsa'i dwangs ma rgyus pa brdad pa 'dra ba de yang bsregs / rnam shes mar me la phu btab pa ltar bsad/ rghaṃ thig le āXdang bcas pa bdag gi snying gar thim pas tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsam/ de nas phur pa'i dbal nas bzung klad la lan gsum bskor bas snang srid thams cad phur pas gang gzi brjid ldan par bsam la kī la yi sngags bzlas/ bdag gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros khams gsum phur pas gang ba la phog mchod pa phul bas mnyes te sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dang dngos grub thams cad bdag la thim par bsam/ phur rtse gyen du bstan nas hūṃ drag po lan gsum brjod pa'i rkyen gyis bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer ba thag lta bu 'og min
du 'phros pa'i sne la dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes āXdakar po'i rnam par rang gi snying gar yod pa de bskyon nas phaṭaXdrag po gsum brjod pa'i rkyen gyis kho'i rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su 'phang bar bsam/ 'di ni bdag phur gzas pa po gsum gsob pa'i gnad khyad par can yin no/ lam 'di la brten nas phur bu mkhan po gdab las la brten nas sangs rgyas pa yin4༷༷ de ltar phur pa'i rgyud dang man ngag nas btus pa tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa can rnams de ltar yin lags/ de tsam mi lcogs na gzhung 'di ga'i dngos bstan gyi man ngag khyad par can tshe khrus cig chod kyi dmigs pa ni/ rang gi mdun du dam can rnams phung gis byung sgrol ba'i las la zhugs/ bdag gis phur ba sgril bas phur pa las phur chung dpag tu med pa 'phros/ kho'i spyi bo nas mar zhugs/ rkang mthil du rtsar bton lus bsgral/ rnyu steng nas zhugs nas lkog mar bton ngag bsgral/ snying gar btab yid bsgral phur bu'i rtse mo mgar gyi so mal nas bton ma thag pa lta bu des rig drug gi sa bon bsregs/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes byi'u ka lanta ga'i mgo bo tsam zhig 'dug pa de yang bsregs/ rnam shes phur pa'i khong seng nas yar drangs/ rgya mdud 'og ma la khro mo bcu/ rgya mdud gong ma la khro bo bcu/ lcim gzhog la phra thabs nyi shu gnas pa'i phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du
༄tshi/ /gnas spar tshe lhag gi dṛ ljang gu phur ces blangs/ lag g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis snying gar stim par gsungs/ de lta bu'i dmigs gnad dang bstun pa sgril zhing bsgral lo/ mthar gri gug gam sgrol gris gtub pa ni/ thog mar lag g.yas de nas rkang g.yas/ de nas rkang g.yon lag g.yon mgo bo de nas smad/ de nas lto ba rgya gram du gtub/ ling ror bdud rtsi bran la/ dug gsum gyi ngo bo sha khrag rus pa rnams bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin stong gsum gang ba dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs khro bo khro mo sprul pa dang yang sprul rnams zhal gnam sa bsgrad pa tsam gyi nang du lhag ma ma lus par gsol bar bsam/ hūṃ dpal chen 'bor bcas zhal phyes shigagiX zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pa 'di ngor gtor ma sbran/ lhag ma cung zad tshogs lhag gi steng du blug de yang bsgral pa'i las la brten nas 'tshengs pa gsum 'byung ste/ bsgral bya gnas kyis 'tshengs/ rnal 'byor pa tshe lhag gis 'tshengs/ dam can sha khrag gis 'tshengs pas 'tsheng ba gsum zhes pa'i don tshangs/ de ltar tshogs tha ma'i bsgral ba'i las rgyas bsdus kyi dmigs rim rnams rgyud dang man ngag rig 'dzin gong ma'i gsungs ltar bkod pa yin lags/ de nas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la bzlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūṃ dbus phyogs 'bor lo'i sogs bzlog pa'i gzhung btang skabs gong du
dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus gsum bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phul bas shin tu dgyes te lha tshogs rnams zhal phyir gzigs nas bzlog pa'i las mdzad par bsam ste/ bzlog gzhung gi tshig rjes don dran gyis bdag dang dur khrod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bcu'i dgra bgegs 'byung po yas kyi bdud g.yos pa dang mas kyi sri langs ba dang / bar gyis 'byung ba 'khrugs pa/ byad kha phur kha rbad 'dre rbod gtong sogs mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs spangs byar gyur pa khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi dug lnga dug gsum gyi kun nas blangs pa'i nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs bdag 'dzin a mthas pa'i khang bar bskyed byed kyi mtshan ma thams cad dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa rnams kyis tshar bcad/ snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang / skye 'gro sems can lha dang lha mo'i dug lnga dug gsum ye shes kyi rol par shar ba'i 'khor ba myang 'das su bzlog pa ni bzlog pa thams cad kyi mthar thug yin lags/ de nas tshogs la rol ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa lha tshogs grol du chod pa dang kuco dang tha mal gyi snang zhen sogs spangs te yi nga rgyal gyis lag pa g.yas g.yon dgang blug gis rang bzhin gyi tshogs kyi yo byad rnams zhal phrin las bzhi'i thab khung du phul
༄tshi/ /bas ljags 'jig rten me lha dang lus dkyil gyi lha rnams kyis dgyes shing rol pas phrin las bzhi sgrub pa dang / gzhan yang rtsa gnas rnams su rigs drug gi sa pon rtsa yi ke'i rnam par gnas pa rnams tshogs bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis sbyangs te sbyangs 'bras ye shes lnga thob par bsam pa dang / gzhan yang bsnyen pa'i skabs lha la lha thim pa'i tshul du rol ba sogs tshim pa drug ldan du spyad/ bdag dang rdo rje slob dpon sogs kyi tshogs bsngo bya/ chos nyid kyi bden pa'o/ /gsang sngags kyi byin gyis rlabs so/ /zhes sogs brjod pa'i don rtogs pa'i ngo bo don dam pa'i chos nyid gnas lugs yin pas chos nyid kyi bden pa'o lam sngags lam yin pas gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs so/ de yang bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha'i byin rlabs las byung bas na sangs rgyas kyi mthu'o/ de yang dbang la brten pas na a bhi tsatya'i dus la babs so de ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mthar byung ba'i thabs zab mo ste gnag pa'i las de kho na'o/ zhes sogs/ lhag ma ni gtsang btsog gi lhag ma rnams so sor bshams la sman raka sbran/ e bhrūṃ gtor gzhong drag po'i gzhal yas khang du bsam la zhes sogs lhag ma las byang gi nang ltar btangs pa'i/ rnam pa gcig tu mi bsre rgyu4༷༷ zhes sogs kyi skabs su gtsang rtsog btsog lhag gtsang lhag steng du bsnan nas bsresan rtsub cing las myur/ gtsang
lhag rtsog lhag gi steng du bsnan na 'jam zhing las bul zhesagasungs gi lhag gnyis bsres shing kha phru btabs la mjug tu phyir btang / chos srung gi gtor ma'i rgyun bstan rtsa gsum gtor ma bshams zhing sman raka sbran nas thugs sgrub ltar / hūṃ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po 'das pa'i dus/ zhes sogs kyis bskul te mthar phyi rol du zhal nang bstan gyi phul nas bka' srung dam can rnams kyis sngon gyi dam bca' dran nas so so'i gnas nas g.yag rgod 'brog pa ltar byon nas rin po che'i snod du gtor ma 'dod yon gyi rang bzhin can bzhes ste phrin las bzhi thogs med du sgrub par mos/ bshal chur gtso bo'i pham 'bab 'bru tshom bdud rtsi blug ste thugs kyi phrin las ltar/ hūṃ bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas4༷༷ zhes sogs kyis bstan ma skyongs/ zor gtor lta bu yin tshe sngags pa drag po'i chas su zhugs ste gser skyems grub rjes/ zor lam dbye ba ni bka' brgyad ltar / hūṃ nyon cig snang srid lha ma srin4༷༷ zhes sogs kyi zor lam dbye nas thebs phyogs su phyir thon/ gser skyems sngon du 'gro bas srid pa hu'i dkar gtor bsngos/ rgyab yig sgrags nas dam can bskul zhing zor 'phang pa'i tshig 'di ltar/ bhyoX ma g.yel ma g.yel ma mo khyodagiX zhes sogs zor bskul dang bstun nas/ gtor gzhung gnam lcags las grub pa'i lcags khang gru gsum pa e yi rang bzhin can gyi
༄tshi/ /nang du dgra bo'i khang khyim mi nor thams cad mngon sum ltar bsam nas khrag 'thung khro bo bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i dmags tshogs rnams kyi sku las mtshon cha sna tshogs dang dug gi char phab ste dgra bo mi nor 'khor bcas la rims nad sna lnga mtshon 'khrugs sna bdun/ smyo 'bog nyer lnga/ phyag mtshan mtshon cha sna tshogs char du phab ste rol mo'i sgra dang mtshon cha'i 'ur sgra dang thugs choms kyi sgras snang srid g.yo 'gul 'byung ba ltar gyur te dgra bgegs byad ma las mkhan rnams kyi srung byed gur dral mgon byed kyi lha bskrad/ lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag pa'i sha khrag la khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs rnams kyi rnyu spyang sha la rub pa'am / ngur byas nya rnyed pa ltar chom chom khrol khrol du gsol pas yungs 'bru tsam ma lus pa gsol bar bsam mo/ gtor gzhong gi bshal chu 'bru gsum gyis brlabs nas thugs kyi phrin las ltar bstan ma skyong srung 'khor bsgom/ phyi mig mi lta bar rdo rje slob dpon gyis steng mnan te log sgo drung bro brdung / me chus rgyas 'debs sogs bka' brgyad ltar bya/ nang du sleb nas tshe 'gugs dang / gzhan yang sbyin sreg dang sri gnon sogs so so'i gzhung ltar las byang gi lhag ma'i mgor las sbyor mdzad dgos lags/ dngos grub len chog ni rgyas pa so so'i yin lags/ gtor bzlog dang dus mchod sogs bsdus pa'i
skabs su chad tho bstan skyongs grub rjes dngos grub len pa'i tshig dbang bskur gyi skabs ltar/ hūṃ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams4༷༷ srid pa rdo rje sgrub mdzod cig zhes pa nas dngos grub 'dir stsol cig yoX badzra ki li ki la ya ka yā wakka tsitta a nyiñtsa hūX/ zhes brjod la bsgrub phur dang bsgrub gtor gnas bzhir gnyug dbang bzhi len pa'i sgrub phur dang / gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor oX dkar po las 'od zer 'phros rang gi spyi bor thim pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag bum pa'i dbang thob sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul sku thob par mos/ yang mgrin pa'i āXdamar po las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim pas ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rtsa rlung bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs sku thob par mos yang thugs ga'i hūṃ sngon po las 'od zer sngon po 'phros rang gi snying gar thim yid kyi sgrib pa dag thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la zhugs pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lam 'pho ba bsgom pa la dbang 'bras bu chos sku thob par mos/ yang sgrub gtor lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor mgrin pa snying kha gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rang gi gnas gsum dang lte bar thim pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/
༄tshi/ /dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob/ lam blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po bsgom pa la dbang 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob par mos/ mthar gtor ma'i ye shes pa gshegs4༷༷ dam tshig pa bdud rtsir zhu bar mos la gtor zan dngos grub tu rol/ dngos grub len pa 'di nyin chog dang zhag sbrel lta bu yin na nyin mtha' mar ma gtogs mi dgos/ slar yang gtor ma sman raka sbran nas mchod pa rnams kha gso ste mchod pa ni/ hūṃ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor bcas la/ sogs dang / hūṃ bskal ba me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas4༷༷ sogs bstod pa bya/ lhag chad kha bkang ni/ hūṃ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon du 'khor bcas kyi4༷༷ bsnyen sgrub phrin las : sogs dang / a li ka laṃ rten 'brel snying po zhabs btags ma lan gsum yig brgya sham bu can bzlas 'dod gsol dang mtshan ma rdzas dkyil la 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs brten bzhugs dang su ṭa tidzis me tog 'thor lo gtor dang sgrub pa zhag sbrel sogs yin na bsgrub gtor la yang brten bzhugs bya/ da ni dkyil 'khor gsal btab sogs kyi nyer bsdu ni/ phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa rang nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ de yang thugs srog hūṃ la bsdu/ de yang sdug bsngal gyi bden pa skyed ni gnyis su 'du ba las 'chi ba'i rim pa sbyang ba thugs 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor
bsdu rim ste slar sgyu ma lta bu'i lha sku ste bar srid sbyang ngo / /gyen rje9gas su bsdus nas rje'ogs rim ka dag ngang la mnyam par bzhag de nas bdag nyid dra gas kyi ltar ldang te bsngo smon bkra shis mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ /'khor gsum yongs dag dang rjesasu mthun pa'i bsngo smon la nan tan mdzad do/ /de ltar phrin las phur ba spu gri las/ las byang ltar dmigs rim rnams sngon 'gro bka' brgyad ltar rang shar dngosagazhi dmigs rim rnams gter gzhung kha skong dgosarigs rnams rig 'dzin padma phrin las kyi yig cha rnamasabasdusate bkod/ gdab las dang gtor bzlog dmigs rim rag bsdusarnams 'di nyid kyi lasamatha'i gtso bor sogs bkod pa lasazhib tshag rnams mthong rgyud phyag len dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi zhal rgyun las ji ltar byung ba bzhin 'bad par rigs/ 'di ni rang nyid nyams len byed bder 'di 'dra zhig byung na bsam kyang rim lusasong bar/ bod kyi blon chen mgar chen sdong btsan gyi gdung 'dzin pa lugs gnyisal rnam dpyod kyi spyan yangs pa chosakyi rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i rigs can rnamasakyi rnam thar 'dzin pa rgyal rtse byu ma ba bde skyong rdo rje rab brtan rnam rgyal gyisgsung gisabaskul bar brten nas rang nyid la sbyangs stobasakyi shesabya cha phra yang / rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin sum ldan gu ru padma dang dbyer ma mchisapa rig 'dzin chen po padma bshesaganyen gyi zhal ngag nas gdams pa'i gnad mang po snying la 'phosate nyams su len pa'i ku su lu pa padma'i ming can lngo dgon gyi bla ma kun bzang padma bdud 'dul/ mag/gyisabrisapa 'gal 'khrul nongs pa mchisan phur srung dam can rgya mtsho dang mkhas pa'i tshogs kyisabazod par bzhesalhang 'di yi dge bas kyang snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bkra lhas//
༄tshi/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha bskyed tshul dang bzlas dmigs ji ltar bya ba ni/ na mo gu ru padma ka ra ye/ bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i gnas bcur khro bo bcu dang lte bar khyung dkar po ba spu la khro bo'i tshogs mtshon cha thog pa dpag tu med pas bsrung ba'i go cha ltar gsal 'debs pa ni bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ phyogs mtshams brgyad dang steng 'og gnyis dang bcur phra thab phyag gnyan dang bcas pa gsal 'debs pa ni phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'bor/ bdag dang phyogs bcu khro be'i dkyil 'bor shar gyi khro po rnam rgyal gyi bar der rdo rje gzhon nu khro bcu phra phyag sgo ma bka' srung dang bcas pa gong ma bskyed pa'i tshigs gcig gis me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar gsal 'debs pa ni mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor nang mtshan ma rdzas dkyil gnyis kyi bar der/ gdab phur gnyis la thugs kyi sras mchog badzra kī la yang gsal 'debs dgos shing / sras mchog 'di la mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs tshang tshul yang bshad do/ /de ltar bdag mdun gnyis kyi rtsig pa'i nang khyams la dam can ma mo bcu gnyis dang phyi rol gyi dur khrod la mang po bse lcags dung gsum bskyed dgos te ji ltar bskyed tshul ni dkyil 'khor g.yi lho gyams gtso bo'i zhal g.yas mdun ngos su nam gyi tho rangs dang bcas pa'am bse mo bzhi rim
pa bzhin 'khod pa ni/ rdo rje ya byin mthing nag lcags phur 'dril ba bdud rta nag po la zhon pa/rdo rje de byin ser mo gser phur ral pa can gser gyi phur pa 'dril ba gza' ser po la zhon pa/ rdo rje bse byin dmar mo bse phur gyi ral pa can bse yi phur pa 'dril ba btsan rta zhur la zhon pa/ rdo rje phag byin ljang mo g.yu phur gyi ral pa can g.yu yi phur pa 'dril ba klu rta sngon po la zhon pa rnams bsam/ 'di bzhi la sa bdag ma chen mo bzhi yang grags so/ /dkyil 'khor gyi byang khyams gtso dra'i g.yon zhal dmar po'am mdun ngos su nam gyi stod la dam bca' pa'i shwa na ma bzhi 'khod pa ni/ shwa na mu kha mthing nag mi mo lcags kyi mgo can lcags phur 'dril zhing lcags spyang mgo dgu la zhon pa/ shwa na mu kha nag mo g.yu phur 'dril ba g.yu yi khyi mo ral can la zhon pa/ shi la mu kha ser mo gser gyi mgo can gser phur 'dril ba gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad la zhon pa/sring ga mu kha dmar mo zangs phur 'dril ba zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum la zhon pa rnams so/ /dkyil 'khor gyi shar khyams gtso bo'i dbus zhal mthing ga'i mdun ngos su nam gyi gung la dam bcas pa'i re ti mched bzhi bdag nyid ma bzhi 'khod pa ni/ re ma ti nag mo ral pa can mchog phur 'dril zhes mi rkang gi phur pa 'dril ba dril rta rkang gsum la zhon pa/ re ma ti ser nag rma bya'i thul ba can mchog phur 'dril ba chu glang sngon po la
༄tshi/ /chen pa/ re ma dzaXdamar nag re lde nag po gsol shing mchog phur 'dril ba sha ba yu mo la zhon pa/ re ma dzu ljang nag dar nag gi gos su gsol zhing mchog phur ba rnga mo ga ba la zhon pa rnams so/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol dur khrod brgyad lho khyams la sa bdag ma bzhi'am bse mo bzha'i ming po dung gi skyes bu ging chen bzhi'am dmag dpon bzhi yang rim bzhin du pra ma ra dza srin po'i ging dkar po dung phur 'dril ba/ ya ma ra dza gshin rje'i ging sngon po ral spri dang phur pa 'dril ba/ da sha gri lpa bdud kyi ging dmar po ral gri dang phur pa'adril ba/ yakṣa spri lpa gnod byed gyi ging ser po phur pa 'dril ba/ dur khrod gyi byang khyams su sha na ma bzhi'i ming po bse'i skyes bu bzhi yang rim pa bzhin du srin po'i skyes bu srin po ging chen dkar po dung phur 'dril ba/ gshin rje'i skyes bu ya ma nag po lcags phur 'dril ba/ ya bdud skyes bu ser po mi ring dmar po zangs phur 'dril ba/ gnod byed skyes bu mon pa mi ring sngon po g.yu phur 'dril ba/ dur khrod kyi shar khyams su bdag nyid ma bzhi'am re ti mched bzhi'i ming po lcags kyi skyes bu bzhi ni rim pa bzhin du shar bdud dkar po mche ba gtsigs pa dung gi phur pa 'dril ba/ lho bdud sngon po ral pa can g.yu phur 'dril ba/ nub bdud nag po zhags pa dang phur pa 'dril ba/ byang bdud ljang gu ral gri dang phur bu 'dril ba/ de ltar dkyil
'khor gyi nang khyams sgo byang shar gsum du dam can gyi ma mo bcu gnyis dang / de bzhin dur khrod kyi phyogs gsum po der bse lcags dung gsum gyi skyes bu bcu gnyis bskyed pa las dkyil 'khor dang dur khrod kyi nub phyogs su dam can yab yum gyi lha gnas med pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo'i zhal g.yas g.yon dbus gsum gyis gdul byar de dag gzhugs pa ma gtor gtso por rgyab zhal med pa'i phyir ro/ /sgo bzhir sgo ma bzhi gzhung ltar ro/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor gsum dang sras mchog sgo ma bka' srung rnams bskyed nas/ srog ye shes su bskyed nas srog dbang bskur ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gsum ga la dmigs dgos pas 'og min nas dbang lha rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' lcam dral khro bo khro mo rig 'dzin bcas pamadun gyi nam 'khar spyan drangs te/ hūm̐X ltoX rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams4༷༷ ces sogs kyi gsol ba btab pas nam mkha'i lha rnams kyis/hūṃXltoX thabs kyi spyod pa'i 'gro don dugaX zhes sogs sngags tshig brjod pa dang lhan cig mi bskyod pa bum pa/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan/snang mthas rdo rje/don grub kyis dril bu/ rnam snang gi ming dbang rnams bskur ba'i tshe gtso yum rnams kyi rdo rje'i glu dang / sems dpa' rnams kyis shos brjod/ sems marnams kyisamachod pa 'bul/ khro bos bgegs skrod pa sogs dkyil 'khor gsum ga'i lha rnams la mdzad pa ni bum dbang /
༄tshi/ /dbang lha yab yum rnams sbyor ba'i byang sems dkyil 'khor gsum gyi spyi bor thim pas gsang dbang / dbang lha rnams rjes chags kyi mes zhu ste dkyil 'khor gsum la thim pas dbang gsum pa de'i ye shes bde stong gi don la rnam par bzhag pa dbang bzhi pa rnams thob/dbang bskur ba'i chu lhag gyen du 'khyil ba'i dbang rtags rigs lngas dbu brgyan par mos pa ni lugs 'di'i khyad par gyi dbang bskur yin no/ /spyan 'dren pa bstod pa'i bar rnam nges dang sgrub chen chog khrigs ltar ro/ / rmya/ bsnyen dmigs ni gong du bshad pa ltar dkyil 'bor gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams gsal ba'i ngang nas rang dang mdun bskyed rdo rje gzhon nu gnyis kyi thugs par ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra rgyan dang phyag mtshan mi mnga' ba tshon gang ba de'i thugs par nyi ma'i gdan la rdo rje rtse dgu nas 'bru gyen du bslang ba tsam gyi lte bar nyi gdan la thugs srog yi ge hūm̐X sngon po'i mthar oXbadzra kī li kī la ya sarba bigha nan bam hūṃX phaṭa dza hūṃX altoX zhes pa'i yig 'bru gser mdog can spu rtses bris pa tsam gyi g.yas su bskor zhing nang du blta ba bdag mdun gnyis kyi gtso rba'i thugs srog sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer nyi ma'i snying po ltar 'bar zhing 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la 'od zer gyi rtse la mchod sprin spros te mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas yod
zer tshur 'dus bdag la thim pas sgo gsum gyi las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad nyi ma shar ba'i mun ltar dwangs par bsam pa ni bsnyen pa zer/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par rong rong gyur pa dang / de bzhin du gsung yig 'bru/thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par byon ste dkyil 'khor gsum la bstim pa dang / yang 'od zer 'phros pas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang / nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha/ sgra grags thams cad sngags sgrar shes pa de dag kyang thun mthar bdag gis bsgom pa'i rten brten pa la bstim pas gzi brjid rgyas par bsam pa ni bdag bdag byin rlabs sam sgrub pa'i dmigs pa thugs pa'i 'od zer rdo rje'i rwa dbus ma nas gyen du byungs te ye shes sems dpa'i shangs g.yas nas thon/rang gi sna bug g.yas nas phyir thon ste mdun gyi gtso dra'i shangs g.yon nas zhugs thugs pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i shangs g.yon nas rdo rje'i rwa dbus ma nas zhugs thugs srog sngags 'phreng la bskor te thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ slar yang rdo rje'i rwa dbus ma nas gyen du byung te ye shes sems dpa' dang gtso bo gnyis kyi shangs g.yas nas phyir phyungs te/ rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i sna g.yon dang thugs pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i
༄tshi/ /sna g.yon nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i rwa dbus su zhugs te thugs srog sngags 'phreng la bskor ba 'di 'gal me ltar drag tu 'khor zhing bzlas pa ni nye bsnyen do li'i bzlas pa zer/ thun mthar dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar gcod zhi ba dang / 'od zer ser po 'phros te sdang srid 'bor 'das kyi tshe dpal yon tan thams cad bsdus te rang la bstim pa rgyas pa dang / 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bus snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad dbang du bsdu ba dang / 'od zer ljang nag me'i tshwa tshwa dang mtshon cha'i dbal lta bu 'phros te bar gcod dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa drag po ste las bzhi'i dmigs pa 'di la sgrub pa chen po zer/ de ltar dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du 'di rnams sems gang dang bstun te re mos kyis bya zhing 'phro 'dus sun na dkyil 'khor gyi lha sku la sems bzung ste sngags bzla ba dang / lha rnams kyi zal nas gsang sngags kyi rang sgra di re ba la sems gtad de bzla ba dang / gtso bor gnas lugs kyi lta ba'i ngang nas bzla ba gal che zhing dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du de rnams kyang ting nge 'dzin gyi grogs su 'gyur phyir thabs la mkhas pas gsungs pa yin cing blo sun cing spun pa ltar snang na gang yang yid la mi bya bar lhod kyis glod la bzhag cing 'dzab bzla ba sogs blo rim dang sbyar nas gsang
sngags mtha' drug shes bya bcu'i tshul gyi nyams su blang ngo/ / mya/ 'di yang byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i sprul pa'i gar mkhan bya nag gi rigs su 'khrungs pa blo bzang padma 'phrin las thegs mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'dus sde zhes dam pa de nyid kyi gsungs pa'i byang gter phur pa spu gri'i sgrub chen chog khrig phyag len snying po rab gsal dang lhan thabs yang yig 'dod dgu'i gter mdzod gnyis las legs par phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'o// //
༄༅/ /phur pa'i las sbyor bsreg hom gyi rim pa chog khrigs su bkod pa bzhugs so/ /
dgo༅/ /na 31 baphros 11 dha pyose/ srid gsum phur bu'i rgyas gdab cing / /khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag /dpal chen rdo rje g.yin nu la/ brgyud nas sbyin bsregs phrin las bstan/ /lho gser mdzod ser po nas byon pa'i chosasde byang gter phur ba dril sgrub gyis/ kha bskyongs las/ mnan bsrega'aphangs gsum las rgyas pa zur na byung bzhin bya dgosakyang / 'dir sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i tshogs tha ma'i gdab kha zin nas drag po'i sbyin bsregagi mtshon don sbyin bsregamadzad srol yod pa'i yo byad bshams pa ni/ sman rag gtor ma dpal bzhosachung ngu zhigadang spro na nyer spyod kyang bshams/bsregs rdzas mar khu dang yungs dkar nag dugakhrag shogaling ga skye mched dod pa rkang lag bsgrad pa de bcongs pa'i tshul gnas yigadang bcasapa lto bar 'gugs pa'i spel tshigaphyir yigamago nang bstan gyisadamod mo dza khroX gyisabaskor/'dre khrang kho na yin phyir tshe bla dag mi bri/ zan ril byas shing me chu'i sbyangs pa byas la dugakhrag gisabyugapa gong du gdab kha'i tshe dgugs gzhungs dang gdab las byas pa rnams g.yas su bzhag gsungs pa ltar dang /de nas cung zad rgyas par byed nas 'bul 'dod na drag po'i shing yam shing sha tshil sna tshogs/ khrag sna yungs dkar sran ma dugarna rusapa so ba yungs nag skye tshe
༄tshi/ /sogs 'bru sna tshogs ro resasogs gosasna lan tshwa rma bya'i mdongs drag po gu gul sogs drag po'i sposasna tshogs rnams bshams/ mdun du lcags slang gi nang du me hom gru gsum tsigs/ dang po ni/ hūm̐XcaX rtog med ye gosas dam rdzas bdud rtsi dang caX 'a'osad sku(na sna lnga'i longs spyod rgya chen spungasacaX chags med rakta'i rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'khrugacaX badzra kī la ya yi dngos grub stsolacaX raṃ yaṃ zhe'oX oX āXhūṃX ༷༷ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃX hrī thāX oX kha ta lam̐ bhrūṃ ma hā ba linta āX oX ma hā rakta dzwa la ni hūṃXcaX mchod pa byin gyisarlabs la 'di skad do/ /hūṃXcaX thams cad ye shes chos 'phrul yina'oX dri zhim bdug spos dhu las byung caX bkrag mdangs me tog pu las byungacaX gsal ba'i mar me a las byung caX gtsang ma'i dri chab gha las: bcud ldan lha bathegs ne las: snyan pa'i rol mo sha: thams cad ye shes mchod pa'i rdzasacaX oX badzra dhu pe hūm̐XcaX sogs/ shabha āXhūm̐X ༷༷ badzra sarba pu: me gha āXhūm̐XcaX dngosa'abyor mchod chog khyo bral gyi khyim nas me blangs te sbar ba'i
me las byung ba'i me lce'i a mṛ ta'i bsang / swā bha wasasbyangs/ kī la ya lan gsum gyisabasangs sbyangs byas nas 'di skad doX stong pa'i ngang las drag po'i thab khung gru gsum pa me rab tu 'bar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus sugiX rdo rje brag chen padma dngagiXnyi zla sde brgyad ru tra'i stengagiX hūm̐X dang rdo rje'i 'phro 'du las4༷༷ me lha rdo rje gzhon nu'i skugiX dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir bsgradagiX g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal4༷༷ rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga g.yas4༷༷ me dpung 'bar ba kha ṭwāṃ g.yon4༷༷ tha ma'i phyag gnyis phur ba 'dril4༷༷ dbu skra khams nag gyen du brdzis4༷༷ khrag 'thung rigs lngas dbu la brgyan4༷༷ rdo rdze khyung gaphregag bar nang khengs4༷༷ dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rjerdzogs4༷༷ sku la bskal pa'i me dpung 'baraltoX phyogs bcur 'phro zhing srid gsum bsregs4༷༷ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing ltoX rdo rje tho khrag 'khril sbyor stobs4༷༷ dpal chen yab yum thugs ka nas4༷༷ hūm̐X bcu rdo rje'i 'phro 'du las4༷༷ khro bcu yab yum khra thabs rnams4༷༷ kun kyang sku mdog mthing nag rngams4༷༷ zhal gcig phyag gnyis phur ba 'dril4༷༷ sku smad phur ba'i dbal dang ldan4༷༷ khra thabs lcags kyu phur ba 'dril4༷༷ rdo rje khyung ga31gas bar snang khengs4༷༷ dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs4༷༷ dpal chen sku yi gnas bcur bltams4༷༷ thugs kyi sras mchog kī la ya4༷༷ khrag 'thung bzhi bcu rtsa bzhis bskoraltoX sgo srung khro mo bzhi dang bcas4༷༷ bka' nyan srung ma bcu
